The…
items.description: About Tripadvisor The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP) include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork. About the Role At Tripadvisor Experiences, the only thing we love more than travel is data. We slice it, we dice it, and we use it to empower our decision-making. As a Product Data Scientist, you’ll be the analytical backbone of one or more product pods. You’ll own measurement and reporting, support experimentation, and surface the insights that drive product decisions — while actively developing your skills in more advanced analytics methods. This is a role for someone with strong foundational data science skills who is energised by the opportunity to grow. What You’ll Do Experimentation Design and analyse A/B tests across Viator’s marketplace, applying sound statistical methods to interpret results and support confident decision-making Champion experimentation best practices: power calculations, guardrail metrics, and multiple testing corrections. Develop your mastery of causal inference and advanced experimentation techniques (e.g., difference-in-differences, propensity scoring, synthetic controls) as you apply them to answer questions that can't be randomized — such as measuring the impact of pricing changes on supplier retention or the long-term effect of personalization on traveler LTV. Strategic Analysis & Measurement Own the measurement framework for your product area: define key metrics, build the instrumentation to track them, and surface insights that move the needle. Conduct exploratory analyses and deep dives into our data, using various data science approaches, to inform product decisions; for example, using tree-based or regression modeling to identify signals of high LTV Enable self-service through scalable datasets, metrics, dashboards and reporting frameworks Translate analytical outputs into actionable insights and clear product recommendations: not just ‘here’s the data,’ but ‘here’s what it means for the next sprint and how we should test it.’ Stakeholder Management & Communication Act as a thought partner with product managers and engineers to ensure the right data questions are being asked Translate analyses into clear narratives that are accessible to non-technical audiences — emphasising actionable insights and ‘so what’ over technical detail. Be a champion of unbiased, rigorous analysis — including when the data doesn’t support a stakeholder’s hypothesis; willingness to be the voice of inconvenient truths is a core expectation of this role. What You’ll Bring Several years in a data science, analytics, or quantitative research role at a data-driven organization; strong product analysts who are actively upskilling in data science methods are encouraged to apply Advanced SQL skills and hands-on experience querying and manipulating large datasets Proficiency with data visualisation tools (Tableau, Looker or equivalent) Experience with the full A/B testing process, from test design to results interpretation Some proficiency in Python for analysis, experimentation and exploratory modeling A track record of using data insights to influence product or business decisions Comfort with ambiguity: you can define a question when it isn’t handed to you, and you’re energised by incomplete information rather than paralysed by it A growth mindset: you’re actively upskilling in more advanced analytics methods and always willing to learn new tools and techniques Nice to Have Exposure to more advanced statistical methods and causal inference techniques — e.g. propensity scoring, synthetic controls, difference-in-differences, Bayesian approaches Familiarity with LLMs or NLP tooling for analytics use cases (e.g., content classification, dataset enrichment) Experience in travel or e-commerce; understanding of two-sided marketplace dynamics, geo-based demand variation, or supplier/consumer trade-offs #LI- Remote #LI-SM1

items.title: Data Analytics & ERP Consultant
items.summary: We are currently recruiting a Data Analytics & ERP Consultant to work with our Awards Management Unit.
items.description: We are currently recruiting a Data Analytics & ERP Consultant to work with our Awards Management Unit. This is a 3-month, remote independent consultant contract, where candidates are ideally able to work during working hours in EST, EEST and/or AST time zones. At Relief International , we are committed to building a representative, inclusive and authentic workplace. We strongly encourage applications from candidates from minoritized backgrounds and those who bring lived experience of the contexts in which we work. Statement of Work Consultancy Title: Data Analytics & ERP Consultant Location where the Services are to be performed: Remote Contracting Manager: Global Awards Director, with technical reporting to the Global Awards and Donor-Compliance Coordinator, and Global Partnerships Advisor (joint technical oversight) Timings: 34 days worked across 3 months Dates: September 15, 2026 – December 15, 2026 Pre Hire Checks Requirements: Standard pre contracting checks. About Relief International Relief International is an international non-profit organization that partners with communities impacted by conflict, climate change and disaster to save lives, build greater resilience and promote long-term health and wellbeing. We work in countries across Africa, Asia, and the Middle East, providing Health and Nutrition, WASH (Water, Sanitation, and Hygiene), Education and Livelihoods programming that creates the foundation for community resilience. Scope and Nature of Services: Relief International 's Awards Management Unit (AMU) is responsible for award and partnership management across the full grant lifecycle, from pre-award review, contracting, modifications, and compliance reporting, to close-out. This includes direct oversight of the partner and sub-award lifecycle across country offices: partner due diligence, SGA and drafting, partner performance, alongside prime award compliance and donor reporting obligations. AMU is completing a 2025 update to the NetSuite Partnerships Module (originally built in 2023), which will become the system of record for both award and partner data. Ahead of full NetSuite roll-out, AMU relies on country-office award and partner matrices maintained outside the system, we need these data to be visualized, to enable AMU's to report in real time on award/sub-award volumes, ICR, partner status, due diligence (DD) compliance, and cost-contribution tracking. AMU requires a consultant to professionalize this reporting in the interim and to ensure continuity into NetSuite once the transition is complete. Objective To strengthen AMU's data management and reporting capability by (a) consolidating and visualizing current country-office award data into a live Power BI dashboard, and (b) preparing data structures, logic, and reporting continuity for the NetSuite Partnerships Module transition, including bridge solutions for the interim period. Information, services or resources to be provided by the consultant: The consultant is expected to be able to carry any of the following tasks: Data Consolidation & Management Review existing country-office award matrices and identify inconsistencies, duplication, and gaps against AMU's reporting needs. Lead the design and maintain a consolidated master dataset (awards, sub-awards, partners) with a clear data version control. Establish a standard data submission template and validation/QA process for country offices. Lead the design database for AMU to launch, collect COs KPIs and how to manage and visualize these data. Reporting & Power BI Dashboard Build and maintain a live Power BI dashboard connected to the consolidated dataset (and later to NetSuite), refreshed on an agreed cadence. Ensure the dashboard is structured for role-based access (AMU, Country Directors, senior management). NetSuite Transition Support Interim/bridge solution: provide a temporary data and reporting mechanism that covers AMU's needs while NetSuite is not yet fully live. NetSuite alignment: map dashboard fields and logic to the Award and partnerships Module's fields, current requirements, and workflows so reporting migrates cleanly once NetSuite goes live. Post-transition continuity: advise on and help configure NetSuite. Analytics Connect / API connectivity so Power BI can pull live from NetSuite, and document the reporting logic for AMU and the dev team. Consultant Profile Essential requirements: Proven experience in humanitarian/development sector data management (NGO experience strongly preferred). Advanced Power BI skills Working knowledge ERP/grants-management systems. Understanding of sub-award/grants-management concepts: ICR/NICRA, cost share/match, FFATA, due diligence and risk assessment, OCA. Demonstrated ability to design bridge/interim data solutions during system transitions, adaptable and sustainable. Desired requirements: Product management or business-analyst background, able to translate functional requirements into technical specs for a dev team (relevant given the ongoing NetSuite transition). Prior experience with multi-country data collection from field/country offices with variable data quality and connectivity. Data governance / data quality framework experience (validation rules, audit trails, version control). Familiarity with UN and other major institutional donor reporting requirements. Skills and Competencies: Proven ability to deliver reporting solutions with evolving data, prioritizing usable outputs. Excellent stakeholder engagement skills, with experience training or supporting non-technical, multi-country field staff to ensure timely data submission. Prior experience supporting a data or systems migration from a legacy platform to a new system. Flexibility to align delivery schedule with the ERP system development timeline and go-live milestones. Strong documentation skills, including data dictionaries and technical handover materials for both non-technical and technical audiences. RI Values. Guided by the humanitarian principles of humanity, neutrality, impartiality, and independence, as well as “Do No Harm,” Relief International Values: We value: Integrity Adaptability Collaboration Inclusivity Sustainability How To Apply To apply for this post, click on the Apply button in the job advert page. You will be asked to upload a CV and Cover Letter (Proposal). The cover letter should be one page, and outline your proposal on how you would deliver the services outlined above. Please include your daily rate, and timelines where possible. Closing Date September 7, 2026. As a humanitarian organization, Relief International is committed to the safeguarding of all those we come into contact with through our work. We are committed to the core humanitarian principles regarding prevention of sexual exploitation and abuse. Relief International expects all staff and volunteers to share this commitment and uphold the values and behaviors outlined in the Code of Conduct. Recruitment to all roles in Relief International include a criminal records self-declaration, references, and other pre-employment checks, which may include police and qualifications checks. items.summary: AffirmedRx is on a mission to improve health care outcomes by bringing clarity, integrity, and trust to pharmacy benefit management.
items.description: AffirmedRx is on a mission to improve health care outcomes by bringing clarity, integrity, and trust to pharmacy benefit management. We are committed to making pharmacy benefits easy to understand, straightforward to access and always in the best interest of employers and the lives they impact. We accomplish this by bringing total clarity to business practices, leading with clinical approaches, and utilizing state-of-the-art technology. Join us in improving health care outcomes for all! We promise to do what’s right, always. Position Summary: The Data Scientist (AI/ML) designs, builds, and validates the advanced analytics that turn pharmacy, claims, clinical, and member data into decisions. This is a hands-on modeling role: the person owns machine learning models end to end, applies AI and natural language processing to unstructured clinical and member data, resolves member identity across fragmented data sources, and packages results into tools and dashboards the business can use. The role sits at the intersection of data science, clinical/pharmacy reporting, and applied AI, and partners closely with data engineering, clinical, reporting, and client-success teams. What you will do: Machine Learning and Predictive Modeling: Build predictive and prescriptive ML models for pharmacy cost and risk (e.g., forecasting second-year member spend), including feature engineering, model selection, and explainability analysis (e.g., SHAP-based feature attribution) Develop member-level risk and comorbidity scoring, mapping drug identifiers (NDC → ATC) to clinical conditions and severity weights, and validating outputs against edge cases Apply ML to automate high-effort clinical operations processes (e.g., prior-authorization override automation), moving manual workflows into rules-based and model-driven pipelines Applied AI and Natural Language Processing: Use AI/NLP to analyze unstructured member and clinical text — sentiment analysis, topic modeling, and tokenization of open-ended survey and feedback data Apply AI tooling (LLMs / copilots and internal AI services) to automate clinical policy and documentation workflows, including prompt design, output validation, and controls against hallucination and format drift Contribute to the organization’s broader AI direction: evaluating models, defining evaluation/answer-key datasets, and building drift and validation checks for AI outputs Member Identity Resolution and Data Quality: Design and maintain probabilistic (fuzzy) matching logic to assign and reconcile unique member identifiers across carriers and source systems, including collision handling, cluster analysis, and audit/logging frameworks Monitor and improve match rates, investigate false positives and fragmentation, and document data lineage and safeguards against duplicates Clinical and Pharmacy Analytics: Produce clinical and pharmacy analytics such as medication adherence and persistence (drug-, class-, and NDC-level), aligned to compliance requirements (e.g., URAC / PQA measures) QA and validate reporting products (e.g., pharmacy trend dashboards, PMPM metrics), reconciling data-point discrepancies across source systems Analytical Tooling and Delivery: Build analytical tools and prototypes (e.g., formulary/tier decision tools and cost-comparison tools), including lightweight front ends (e.g., Streamlit) for sales, clinical, and pricing use Deliver validated datasets and tables into the data warehouse in partnership with data engineering, and support the transition of prototypes into production Validation, Documentation, and Collaboration: Own QA and validation for analytical outputs, including auditing of claims files and validation of model results before release Document models, logic, data sources, schedules, and troubleshooting steps to make work reproducible and auditable Collaborate across clinical, reporting, pricing, client-success, and engineering stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into analytical specifications What you need: Degree in a quantitative field (data science, statistics, computer science, applied math) or equivalent experience 2–3 years of experience using Python and SQL for data analysis, machine learning, NLP, data quality, and record-matching solutions. items.title: Performance Analytics and Dashboard Specialist
items.summary: Position SummaryThe Project Monitor operates the performance, data, and compliance monitoring system for project.
items.description: Position Summary The Project Monitor operates the performance, data, and compliance monitoring system for project. This individual translates the QASP and PWS into measurable definitions, reliable data-collection processes, dashboards, quarterly reports, and corrective-action workflows. The Project Monitor provides an objective view of whether TTA, pilots, products, and deliverables are timely, high quality, useful, and likely to produce sustainable results. Core Responsibilities Develop and maintain the performance-measure dictionary, data-collection plan, reporting calendar, source documentation, quality checks, and dashboard required by the QASP. Track the number, type, frequency, duration, level of effort, recipients, outputs, and status of TTA and program-support activities by quarter. Measure recipient roles, knowledge gain, use of rapid-cycle evaluation and learning, satisfaction, implementation progress, product use, and sustainability indicators. Monitor the PWS requirement that at least 85 percent satisfaction be achieved for sponsored training and technical assistance activities and flag emerging performance gaps. Compile quarterly performance and outcomes reports and provide validated monitoring inputs for monthly status reports, the annual report, briefings, and pilot learning products. Track deliverable schedules, review cycles, Government comments, acceptance status, quality findings, risks, corrective actions, and evidence of closure. Support pilot-site data planning, baseline and monitoring data, data dictionaries, data-use controls, privacy protections, missing-data rules, and cross-site synthesis. Conduct data-quality checks, reconcile source records, document limitations, and prevent unsupported causal claims or overstatement of results. Coordinate with the Project Leader and SME and Content Manager on logic models, measures, analytic questions, promising-practice evidence, and product performance. Required Qualifications At least five years of experience in program monitoring, performance measurement, evaluation, data analysis, quality assurance, or federal contract compliance. Demonstrated ability to define measures, design data-collection tools, validate data, develop dashboards, and produce clear performance reports. Experience with qualitative and quantitative data, surveys or feedback instruments, data dictionaries, documentation, and data-quality controls. Working knowledge of privacy, confidentiality, secure data handling, Section 508, and responsible reporting of limitations. Strong analytical writing and ability to explain performance findings to project leaders, technical staff, pilot sites, and nontechnical client audiences. Preferred Qualifications Graduate training in program evaluation, public policy, statistics, economics, sociology, public administration, or a related field. Experience with TANF, HMRF, means-tested programs, rapid-cycle learning, multi-site pilots, or human-services administrative data. Proficiency with Power BI, Tableau, Excel, R, Stata, SPSS, SAS, Qualtrics, or comparable analytics and survey tools. Education and Experience Bachelor's degree in evaluation, statistics, economics, public policy, social science, public administration, or a related field required; master's degree preferred. Five or more years of directly relevant experience is preferred. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: What We Need Corpay is currently looking to hire a Senior Manager, Operational Excellence & AI Transformation within our Corpay Payables organization. As the Senior Manager, Operational Excellence & AI Transformation, you will lead enterprise-wide initiatives that simplify operations, improve customer experience, accelerate business growth, and unlock the value of automation and Artificial Intelligence (AI). You will combine deep operational excellence expertise with a passion for digital transformation, Lean Six Sigma methodologies, AI-enabled process optimization, and organizational change. This individual thrives in ambiguity, influences across organizational boundaries, and delivers sustainable improvements that drive revenue, reduce cost, improve speed to market, and elevate. You will report to the Sr. Director, Operational Excellence and regularly collaborate with Operations, Product Management, Technology, Finance, Sales, and Customer Success to identify opportunities, challenge existing processes, and deliver innovative solutions that create measurable business value. How We Work As a Senior Manager, Operational Excellence & AI Transformation, Corpay will set you up for success by providing: Company-issued equipment + remote access Formal, hands-on training Role Responsibilities The responsibilities of the role will include: Enterprise Transformation Lead strategic operational transformation initiatives across multiple business functions. Partner with executive leadership to identify opportunities that improve revenue, reduce costs, improve customer experience, and increase operational scalability. Serve as an internal consultant, providing recommendations supported by data, financial analysis, and business cases. Lead Lean Six Sigma initiatives focused on eliminating waste, improving quality, and reducing operational complexity. Establish future-state operating models that enable sustainable growth. items.title: Data Liaison (Business Analytics & Insights)- 6 Month Contract
items.summary: OGC is a boutique research and consulting agency specializing in data-driven strategy, quantitative analytics, and Customer Experience (CX) program design and optimization.
items.description: OGC is a boutique research and consulting agency specializing in data-driven strategy, quantitative analytics, and Customer Experience (CX) program design and optimization. We work with some of the world's largest organizations across a variety of industries, including Financial Services, Specialty Retail, Telecommunications, Hospitality, and Software, helping them gain a deep understanding of their customers, develop actionable insights, and improve business processes. Our client is a global leader in the Consumer Packaged Goods industry, with a focus on delivering data-driven insights that support commercial decision-making and business growth. Their Growth Analytics team develops dashboards and reporting solutions used by senior leadership across the organization. They are seeking a Data Liaison to bridge the gap between business stakeholders and technical development teams, ensuring reporting solutions accurately reflect business needs and industry metrics. This is a 6-month remote contract with the potential for extension. About the Role The ideal candidate is analytical, commercially minded, and an exceptional communicator who enjoys translating business needs into actionable data requirements. You will work closely with business stakeholders, insights teams, and analytics developers to ensure dashboards and reporting solutions are built using the correct business logic, calculations, and data sources. This role is ideal for someone with experience in business analytics, commercial insights, or consumer insights who understands both the language of the business and the language of data. should be comfortable working closely with technical teams, translating business requirements into technical specifications, and validating data before it reaches senior leadership. You'll also play an important role in helping the analytics team build a stronger understanding of the business, enabling them to become increasingly self-sufficient over time. Responsibilities Include Serve as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, insights teams, and analytics developers, translating executive requests into clear business requirements, data specifications, and analytical approaches. Review dashboards, calculations, and reporting logic before release, ensuring the correct business logic, methodologies, metrics, and data sources (including syndicated datasets such as Nielsen) are used while proactively identifying and resolving reporting inaccuracies. Participate in business and executive reporting discussions to understand business priorities, reporting requirements, and how data is used to support decision-making. Document business metrics, calculation methodologies, and data source guidance to establish consistent reporting standards and best practices. Coach and mentor analytics developers to strengthen their understanding of business metrics, commercial context, and reporting expectations, with the goal of enabling greater independence over time. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve reporting processes, strengthen communication between business and technical functions, and develop scalable documentation and best practices that enhance the long-term capability of the analytics team. Requirements Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Statistics, Data Analytics, Marketing, or a related field. 4+ years of experience in Business Analytics, Commercial Analytics, Consumer Insights, Market Research, Strategy, or a related analytical role. Experience within Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG), Retail, or a similar commercial environment is strongly preferred. Experience working with syndicated data sources, particularly Nielsen, with the ability to determine the most appropriate data source for different business questions. Strong understanding of retail and commercial performance metrics, including velocity, points of distribution, market share, merchandising, pricing, and related KPIs. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to validate data, calculations, business logic, and reporting accuracy. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to translate business requirements into clear guidance for technical and analytics teams. Experience collaborating with analytics, BI, engineering, or dashboard development teams in a cross-functional environment. Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment. Experience with business intelligence platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar reporting tools is advantageous. Technical coding or dashboard development experience is not required; however, the ability to engage credibly with technical teams is essential. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Payments Analyst
items.summary: Payments AnalystStellarTech is a rapidly growing company at the forefront of innovation in the EdTech industry.
items.description: Payments Analyst StellarTech is a rapidly growing company at the forefront of innovation in the EdTech industry. We build and scale educational apps for users around the world, combining data, technology, and an x1000 mindset to create meaningful products and sustainable business models. We are looking for a Payments Analyst to join our Payments Division. Payments sit at one of the most critical points in the customer journey: the moment user intent turns into revenue. As our product portfolio and global presence continue to grow, we need an analyst who will help us keep payment reporting accurate, monitor performance, identify anomalies, and support data-driven improvements across our payment flows. You will gradually take ownership of day-to-day payment analytics while developing deep expertise in transactional data, monetization, and subscription products. What You’ll Do Maintain and improve recurring payment reports and dashboards. Adapt existing reporting for new applications, markets, and business needs. Create analytical reports and data extracts independently. Add new filters and dimensions to existing dashboards. Monitor payment performance, alerts, and week-over-week changes in key metrics. Identify anomalies in payment data and conduct first-line investigations into possible causes. Perform data quality checks and help maintain consistency across multiple data sources. Work with large product and transactional datasets. Support the Payments team with clear conclusions and actionable insights, not just raw data. Collaborate with Payments, Product, Finance, and other cross-functional teams. Identify opportunities to automate recurring reports and analytical workflows. Gradually contribute to more advanced payment analytics, experiments, and business hypotheses. What We’re Looking For 1-3 years of hands-on experience in Data Analytics, Product Analytics, or a similar analytical role. Strong SQL skills and the ability to write queries independently. Practical Python skills for data analysis and automation. Working knowledge of statistics and analytical methods. Experience working with large datasets and real product or business data. Experience creating or maintaining reports and BI dashboards. Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills. Ability to validate data, identify inconsistencies, and investigate anomalies. Ability to clearly explain what you did, what problem you solved, and how the result was useful. Strong attention to detail and respect for data accuracy. An ownership mindset: you do not simply complete tasks but take responsibility for the result. High learning agility and genuine interest in developing within the payments domain. Clear, structured communication and willingness to raise questions or blockers early. Nice to Have Experience working with payment, transactional, billing, or financial data. Experience in subscription-based, web-to-app, fintech, e-commerce, gaming, or other high-volume B2C products. Understanding of monetization models and online payment flows. Experience with AWS Athena or Amazon S3. Experience with Tableau, Apache Superset, Looker, or similar BI tools. Experience automating reports or recurring analytical processes. Personal, academic, or professional projects involving automation, AI tools, or real-world datasets. Previous payments experience is an advantage, but it is not a requirement. Strong analytical fundamentals, ownership, and the ability to learn quickly matter more. What Success Looks Like During your first months, you will learn the Payments Division’s data, reporting logic, and key processes. You will gradually take ownership of recurring dashboards, reports, filters, data extracts, monitoring, and alerting. You will be able to identify issues, explain what is happening in the data, and escalate anomalies with the necessary context. Why You’ll Love Working With Us Direct business impact: Work with data at the point where customer intent becomes revenue. Global scale: Analyze payment flows across multiple products, markets, and payment methods. Valuable expertise: Build your career in payments, transactions, subscriptions, and monetization. Professional growth: Learn directly from an experienced Senior Analyst and gradually take ownership of your analytical area. Modern tools: Work with SQL, Python, AWS Athena/S3, Tableau/Superset, and AI-powered solutions. Innovative environment: Experiment, improve processes, and bring your own ideas. Global remote: Work remotely as part of an international product company. Health support: Company-provided medical expense compensation. AI tools: Company-covered AI subscriptions and other tools. Balance: 21 days of annual leave plus 10 bank holidays. Collaborative culture: Work with ambitious professionals who value reliable evidence, extreme ownership, energy, and speed. Hiring Process Recruiter Screening Technical Interview Final Interview Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Blockchain Data Analyst & Researcher
items.summary: Why This Role As a Blockchain Data Analyst & Researcher, you will be a pivotal force in our data intelligence efforts, serving primarily as a blockchain data protocol researcher.
items.description: Why This Role As a Blockchain Data Analyst & Researcher, you will be a pivotal force in our data intelligence efforts, serving primarily as a blockchain data protocol researcher. Your core mission will involve a deep dive into the complex internals and mechanics of various blockchain networks, reverse engineering of sophisticated Decentralized Finance (DeFi) protocols, and translating these complex systems into actionable, structured data. Develop new derivative data models and datasets for client insights and competitive advantages. Map, cleanse, and normalize raw, disparate blockchain data (transaction logs, smart contract events, state changes) into consistent, structured relational and non-relational schemes for consumption by analytics, machine learning, and AI tools. This role requires a unique blend of expertise in distributed systems, data engineering best practices, and a profound understanding of the crypto and decentralized ecosystem. What You’ll Do Maintain an AI-native and blockchain-forward mindset, proactively leveraging emerging trends and generative technologies to stay at the vanguard of the crypto revolution while maximizing work efficiency and uncovering novel, high-alpha data opportunities. Architect Intuitive Data Models: Turn the messiness of on-chain data into elegant, unified abstractions. You'll build the models that provide our users with granular, high-integrity insights across various protocols. Deconstruct DeFi Mechanics: Get under the hood of DeFi protocols. You'll reverse-engineer smart contracts and on-chain events, translating complex interactions into clean, production-grade SQL/dbt models. Scale Our Ecosystem Coverage: Lead the charge in indexing new blockchains. You’ll design the schemas that transform raw chain data into our internal "source of truth," ensuring every block is captured with 100% accuracy. Engineer Signal from Noise: Define the metrics that matter (TVL, Volume, Fees). You’ll be the gatekeeper of data quality, proactively identifying and filtering out wash trading, bot activity, and Sybil attacks. What You'll Need: Experience 3+ years hands-on in Data Science, Data Engineering, or a hybrid role; Blockchain or crypto analytics background strongly preferred, familiarity with on-chain data structures, transaction semantics, and asset classification; Streaming & Lakehouse Apache Flink or Spark Streaming building and operating real-time data pipelines; Apache Iceberg or Apache Hudi managing large-scale Data Lakehouses with schema evolution, time travel, and ACID guarantees over petabytes of raw blockchain data; AWS Data Platform S3 for scalable data lake storage; RDS for structured relational workloads; Spark SQL and PySpark for interactive querying and ad-hoc analysis; Caching & Distribution Familiarity with Data Grid technologies (e.g. Hazelcast, Apache Ignite, Redis) for high-throughput, low-latency data access patterns; Languages & Tooling SQL advanced query writing, window functions, query plan analysis, performance tuning at scale; Python Pandas, Polars for data wrangling; Scikit-learn for model development; Proficient in architecting high-throughput ingestion pipelines that leverage external data sources REST/WebSocket APIs, JSON-RPC node queries; Strong grasp of ETL fundamentals (extract, transform, load), including managing schema mismatches between heterogeneous sources and destinations; Engineering Mindset Systematic approach to debugging: reproducing issues, isolating root cause, validating fixes; Comfortable working with large, semi-structured, or undocumented data sources. Why Join Lukka ? Are you looking for a challenge? Lukka solves the most complex data and technology challenges for an industry that is at the forefront of innovation. At Lukka , we strive to anticipate and respond to the needs of this new and ever-changing ecosystem of digital assets. That was true in 2014, while everyone was focused on trading & buying this new asset class, we were thinking about the tax implications of crypto. That innovative foresight continues today as we evolve and iterate on our product suite to address the regulations and educate our customers. We are looking for passionate, collaborative, and strategic individuals who want to help shape the future of, well, everything – starting with making crypto more accountable. We invest in our teammates, promote from within & are responsible to each other by fostering an inclusive space for curious minds to thrive and innovate. What’s life @ Lukka like? We move fast and continue to be ahead of the curve. You could be part of a growing company bridging the gap between business and blockchain. Here’s some insight into why our team members have joined: Ability to own the projects they work on; Less red tape to take ideas from inception to delivery; Being at the forefront of an industry; Small team, big dreams. Of course, let’s discuss some perks: Opportunity to work directly on data for digital assets, an industry-leading product with well-known clients. Working with multiple AI solutions daily. Exposure to both technical problem-solving and customer-facing challenges. A growing Poland-based team with direct collaboration across US and global stakeholders. A startup-style culture where your impact is visible every day. So you’ve scrolled, your interest is piqued and hopefully read all of the important things...now what? This is an exciting time to join a team that’s at the forefront of this rapidly growing industry. We are looking for people who constantly push themselves to think differently, are ready to face new challenges and chart exciting new paths. If this sounds like you, apply! items.summary: You’re more valuable than ever – And that’s just how we’ll make you feel.
items.description: You’re more valuable than ever – And that’s just how we’ll make you feel. Job Summary The LMS Administrator serves as the primary system administrator and subject matter expert for the organization's Workday Learning platform. This role is responsible for the configuration, administration, governance, optimization, reporting, and ongoing support of enterprise learning technologies. The LMS Administrator partners closely with Learning, Talent Management, IT, Operations and business stakeholders to deliver effective learning solutions, maintain data integrity, support compliance requirements, and drive an exceptional learner experience. This position provides advanced Workday Learning administration, reporting and analytics, troubleshooting, learning program deployment, and support for system enhancements, integrations, and continuous improvement initiatives. The role requires extensive knowledge of Workday Learning functionality, learning operations, data management, business processes, and enterprise learning best practices. Qualifications Education Required: Bachelor’s degree in Informatics, Information Technology, Instructional Design, Education, Business Administration, Human Resources or related fields. • Direct work experience will be considered in lieu of a degree. Work Experience Required: 3+ years of direct experience in Learning Management System (LMS) administration. Significant experience or certification in using Workday Learning LMS. Preferred Qualifications, Education, Licenses, Certifications, Experience, etc.: Workday Learning certifications highly desired. Experience with Workday HRIS and API integrations. Experience with Docuware and Sigma to store and analyze data. Troubleshooting skills and knowledge of deeper LMS functionalities. Preferred certifications are desired and include, but are not limited to: Instructional Design, eLearning development, or print design (e.g., ATD, Articulate, Adobe Captivate), Information Technology (e.g., CompTIA, SQL) Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities Advanced knowledge of Workday Learning administration, including learning assignments, certifications, learning campaigns/engagements, course management, learner audiences, security roles, and learning compliance processes. Demonstrated experience administering and optimizing enterprise Learning Management Systems (LMS), including system configuration, user support, reporting, governance, and continuous improvement initiatives. Strong understanding of learning technologies and standards, including SCORM, xAPI, online learning content deployment, learning pathways, certifications, and compliance based training programs. Experience supporting Workday Learning implementations, system enhancements, tenant testing, release management, data migration, and post-implementation optimization activities. Working knowledge of Workday Enterprise Interface Builder (EIB), data imports, mass uploads, integrations, and related data management processes. Ability to build, analyze, and maintain reports, dashboards, and learning analytics to support business decisions, compliance requirements, and learning effectiveness measurement. Knowledge of HRIS and learning system integrations, with an understanding of APIs, data exchanges, and enterprise system architecture. Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to identify root causes, resolve complex technical issues, and recommend scalable system solutions. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts clearly, develop system documentation, and effectively collaborate with stakeholders at all organizational levels. Proven ability to establish and maintain LMS governance standards, administrative procedures, documentation, and quality controls that ensure data integrity and system consistency. Experience managing multiple priorities, projects, and system-related initiatives while maintaining accuracy, organization, and attention to detail. Self-motivated and highly accountable, with the ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and take ownership of system performance and user experience. Demonstrated ability to build strong partnerships across Learning & Development, Talent Management, IT, Operations, and business stakeholder groups. Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint, as well as reporting and data analysis tools such as Workday Reporting, Sigma, Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms. Experience with instructional design and eLearning authoring tools such as Articulate Storyline, Rise, Vyond, Adobe Captivate, or similar solutions is preferred. Commitment to continuous learning and staying current on Workday functionality, learning technology trends, industry best practices, and emerging workforce development solutions. Essential Duties and Responsibilities Workday Learning Administration & Governance Serve as the primary system administrator and subject matter expert for the Workday Learning platform. Configure, maintain, and optimize Workday Learning functionality, including learning assignments, certifications, learning campaigns, learner audiences, security roles, business processes, and system settings. Establish and maintain LMS governance standards, system documentation, administrative procedures, and quality controls to ensure data integrity, security, compliance, and consistency. Evaluate, test, and implement Workday releases, new functionality, and system enhancements to improve organizational learning capabilities and user experience. Ensure compliance with organizational, regulatory, and audit requirements related to learning records and training documentation. items.description: 1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing. About 1Password At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work. If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future. We’re looking for a Senior Revenue Strategy Analyst to join our RevOps Insights team with a dedicated focus on Go-To-Market (GTM) analytics and insights. This senior individual contributor role is embedded directly within the CRO organization to stay close to the business and support our teams in driving upsell and new business within our customer base. The ideal candidate combines strong technical fluency across the data stack with exceptional communication skills and business acumen. You should be just as comfortable debugging SQL as you are discussing pipeline risk with sales leadership. You’ll act as a strategic partner to senior leaders across the GTM team, anticipating data needs, surfacing key insights, and helping guide decision-making with clear, actionable recommendations. This is not just a reporting role. We’re seeking a candidate who’s curious, proactive, and comfortable working in the messy middle, where business context meets technical depth. Based remotely in the USA (with a strong preference for MST and PST timezones), this senior individual contributor role is embedded within the Chief Revenue Officer (CRO) organization and reports to the Sr. Manager, RevOps Insights. What we're looking for: 5+ years of experience using data to drive business decisions within a SaaS or Go-To-Market environment, with a deep understanding of top-of-funnel GTM motions, SaaS metrics, revenue KPIs, and pipeline generation. Proven ability to own relationships with senior GTM leaders, including BDR, Marketing, and Sales stakeholders, as a strategic analytics partner who helps frame the right questions, influence direction, and drive alignment across teams. Experience analyzing and improving top-of-funnel performance, including lead generation, lead quality, BDR productivity, conversion rates, pipeline creation, and the handoff between Marketing and Sales. Strong communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex analysis into clear, executive-ready insights, recommendations, and decision points for BDR, Marketing, and Sales leadership. 5+ years of hands-on SQL experience, with experience building and maintaining data models using dbt to support scalable, trustworthy funnel analysis and reporting. Expertise with visualization tools such as Hex, Looker, or Tableau, and experience building dashboards and self-serve reporting that help GTM teams understand funnel health, pipeline performance, and areas for improvement. Familiarity with revenue technology tools such as Salesforce, Outreach, Gong, ZoomInfo, or 6sense, especially as they relate to prospecting, routing, attribution, activity tracking, and funnel measurement. Strong foundation in statistics and probability, with experience applying forecasting, predictive modeling, or operational optimization techniques to revenue analytics. Track record of managing multiple projects, setting priorities, and delivering measurable business impact across top-of-funnel GTM initiatives What you can expect: Serve as the primary analytics partner to GTM leadership by anticipating needs, shaping the right questions, and translating complex data into strategic, actionable recommendations. Deliver high-impact analyses and dashboards that address critical business challenges and inform executive decision-making. Define, govern, and track GTM key performance indicators (KPIs) to ensure alignment with company goals and evolve them as business needs change. Write optimized Structured Query Language (SQL) queries, build and maintain data build tool (dbt) models, and manage version control using Git to deliver reliable analyses and scalable data pipelines. Design, develop, and own dashboards in Salesforce and Looker that highlight leading indicators, pipeline health, and upsell or new-business opportunities. Partner with Data Engineering to build scalable data solutions and onboard new data sources to support evolving GTM analytics use cases. Lead analytics initiatives from scoping through delivery, managing timelines, stakeholder communication, and measurable business impact. Work directly with GTM executives to diagnose process bottlenecks, test data-driven improvements, and embed analytics into GTM strategy. Maintain clear documentation to ensure consistency, reliability, and strong collaboration across Analytics and cross-functional stakeholders. USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $113,000 USD and $158,000 USD, plus immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs. Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $105,000 CAD and $147,000 CAD, plus immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs. At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set. This posting is for an existing vacancy. Our culture At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first. You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone . Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results. How we’re using AI today Across GTM, we’re transforming the way we work with AI. We expect every seller, CSM, and team member to become a power user, using it daily to work smarter and move faster. AI is already embedded in how we operate – from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs – creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here. This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. Our approach to remote work We believe in the power of remote work, but recognize that in-person connection is important to help us achieve our mission. While we are a remote-first company, travel for in-person engagement is a part of almost all roles, and we require our employees to be ready and willing to take part. Frequency will depend on role and responsibilities, and may include, but is not limited to: annual department-wide offsites, team meetings, and customer/industry events. What we offer We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer: Health and wellbeing Maternity and parental leave top-up programs Competitive health benefits Generous PTO policy Growth and future RSU program for most employees Retirement matching program Free 1Password account Community Paid volunteer days Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly Remote-first work environment *Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in-person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting. You belong here. 1Password is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace that is built on trust, support and respect. We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. Be yourself, find your people and share the things you love. Accommodation is available upon request at any point during our recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please speak to your talent acquisition partner or email us at nextbit@agilebits.com and we’ll work to meet your needs. Remote work is a part of our DNA. Given that our company was founded remotely in 2005, we can safely say we're experts at building remote culture. That said, remote work at 1Password does mean working from your home country. If you've got questions or concerns about this, your talent partner would be happy to address them with you. Successful applicants will be required to complete a background check that may consist of prior employment verification, reference checks, education confirmation, criminal background, publicly available social media, credit history, or other information, as permitted by local law. 1Password uses artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) technologies, including natural language processing and predictive analytics, to assist in the initial screening of employment applications and improve our recruitment process. See here for the latest third party bias audit information. If you prefer not to have your application assessed using AI/ML features, you may opt out by completing this form . For additional information see our Candidate Privacy Notice .

items.description: Job Summary As a member of the Customer Experience team, the Director, Data Analytics ensures timely creation of key Executive and Health plan management reports, as well as providing critical analytical insights. This role will assist in developing, implementing and monitoring the organization's enrollment, utilization and operational-related reporting and analytics to support business and customer satisfaction decision making. Drives analytic engagement among interdepartmental customers including, but not limited to, IT; Finance; Actuarial, Claims, Call Centers and Utilization and Care Management. Manages data analytic staff who assist in the development and execution of standard and ad-hoc reporting along with supporting analysis as needed. Knowledge/Skills/Abilities • Design and develop analytical reporting tools to efficiently measure, monitor, and communicate clinical, operational & financial results. • Lead end-to-end efforts to establish a comprehensive set of actionable reporting metrics, dashboards and scorecards tied to market share growth and Molina member and provider experience. • Support and provide insightful provider/contract and value-based analytics. • Create meaningful cost, enrollment and operational metrics and data visualizations to support monthly operating reviews. • Oversee enrollment/clinical reporting for State and/or Centers for Medicaid &Medicare Serves (CMS) where applicable. • Serve as subject matter expert for any projects and or new business related to areas of oversight. • Collaborate with health plan finance staff in review and analysis of premium rates received from the state(s) for appropriateness. • Act as a liaison to all other internal and external customers on behalf of Molina and data management areas. • Manage, mentor and develop/coach analytical team. Job Qualifications Required Education Bachelor Degree in Business Administration or related field or equivalent of 7 years+ in Managed Care or Medicare related field. Required Experience 10+ years operational experience with Managed Care and/or Medicare. 5+ years in supervisory and/or management experience in Managed Care or Medicare related field. 5 years+ in Excel and financial analysis skills. Ability to work with Power BI, Salesforce and Salesforce Analytics Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or related certification a plus. Strong communication and team/interpersonal skills. Strong leadership capabilities and ability to initiate and maintain cross-team relationships. Ability to work closely with remote staff to ensure State and Federal requirements as well as standard processes are accommodated within the enrollment and premium process. Knowledge of applicable state, federal and third-party regulations. Preferred Education Master degree in Business Administration or related field. To all current Molina employees: If you are interested in applying for this position, please apply through the Internal Job Board. Molina Healthcare offers a competitive benefits and compensation package. Molina Healthcare is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE) M/F/D/V

items.description: Type: Full-time, salaried employment Location: Remote, United Kingdom only. Salary Range: £90,000 - £105,000 + stock options. Who We Are Focal Systems is the industry leader in retail AI solutions. We are headquartered in San Francisco, California with operations in Canada and the UK, and a tech-hub in Poland. We are a Deep Learning first company. Our mission is to automate and optimize brick and mortar retail using deep learning computer vision. Focal Systems has been deployed at scale with some of the top retailers in the world. We seek smart, creative and passionate people who want to help build a great and enduring company and deploy Deep Learning to the world! What You Will Be Responsible For As Senior Product Manager, you will take ownership of how data is processed at Focal, and shape what that path becomes: from the imports that bring a retailer’s planograms, inventory and store metadata into our platform, through the pipelines that turn them into signal, to the metrics and reports their head office acts on. You will work with data engineering, data scientists, analytics, customer success and the retailers themselves. What you build are data products, and the measure of one is what a retailer does differently because of it. This is a hands-on role. You will set direction and priorities as we roll out to hundreds of new stores, but you are also expected to know the systems well enough to be a partner in an engineering design conversation, pull your own numbers when something looks wrong, and hold a strong position in the discussions with customers. What We Are Looking For You are a peer to the engineers you work with, someone who understands the systems well enough to know what is expensive and why and when to push back You are drawn to the seams between teams, where ownership is shared and the hardest problems live You write your own queries and interrogate the answers before anyone else has to, and you can name the business number a data product of yours moved You can change your mind in a technical argument, and you can point to the time you did You have strong judgment about what not to build, and you have killed your own work when it stopped earning its place You use AI as part of how you actually work, and you have built things with it that other people went on to use, not demos you gave once You communicate complicated things crisply to people who do not share your context, including customers hearing an answer they did not want You build things that outlast you, whether runbooks, tooling or documented decisions, because you would rather remove yourself as a dependency than be indispensable What You Will Do Own product direction for the full data path, from how a retailer’s data arrives to what our reports say, and set the priorities where the two ends pull against each other Own how customer data gets into Focal: imports, planograms, store metadata, cut-off configuration, and the chain-specific flows each retailer needs Own what comes out and whether anyone acts on it: the metrics, the reporting APIs, the insight-generating agents, and the customer-facing dashboards a head office runs its week on Run discovery with retailers and store colleagues, and turn what you learn into a product Ship, then find out whether anyone used it, and act on the answer Automate your own work with AI and share what you build with the rest of the product team What You Need to Be Successful 5+ years in product management, including real time on a technically deep product where you owned integrations, data, or both Enough technical depth to reason about APIs, data pipelines and system boundaries, and to be an equal partner in an engineering discussion Experience building for a hierarchy of users who need different things from the same data: a store manager, a regional director and a head of supply chain reading one dataset three ways, served by one configurable surface Hands-on comfort with SQL and the ability to answer your own data questions Fluency in the analytics and BI tooling landscape, and a view on what makes a dashboard worth returning to rather than merely correct Demonstrated ownership of a product roadmap end to end, from problem definition through to something shipped and adopted A track record of getting things done across teams, and the communication to influence engineering and commercial partners Experience working directly with enterprise customers, including holding a position they disagree with Comfortable operating remote-first, across a distributed team Willingness to travel occasionally for store and customer visits What Would Set You Apart Experience in working with high-volume, noisy sensor or computer-vision data Experience with change data capture into a cloud warehouse (ideally Snowflake) Experience shipping AI-powered features, including the call on when a model is good enough to ship Why Focal Systems Joining Focal Systems means becoming part of a company that’s truly making a difference in the retail world. Here’s why you should consider us: Strong Values and Mission: We are a tightly-knit team with an ambitious mission and a strong set of core values, which define our approach to business and have successfully guided us since inception. Exceptional Team: We are a team of hard-working, fun-loving professionals from some of the most eminent universities, research labs, and tech companies of our time. We pride ourselves on recruiting exceptional individuals to help us redefine the state-of-the-art. Outstanding Partners: We work with 10+ of the largest retailers in the world and have a world-class roster of investors, advisors and partners to support & advise us in our endeavours. What we offer We care deeply about the health, happiness, and wellbeing of all of our employees. We offer: Competitive Salary & Attractive Stock Generous Paid Time Off Pension Sick Leave Parental Leave Learning and Development Budget

items.description: The Company Jump is transforming the live sports experience with the only end-to-end fan engagement platform built specifically for sports teams and venues. By focusing on aligned incentives between teams and fans, our platform unifies ticketing, merchandise, and game day operations - creating a smoother, more fan-friendly experience. Jump was founded by e-commerce innovator Marc Lore, MLB legend Alex Rodriguez, and entrepreneur Jordy Leiser. We’re backed by top investors including Alexis Ohanian’s Seven Seven Six and Forerunner Ventures. Our platform powers teams across the NBA, WNBA, and NWSL among other leagues, helping them boost ticket sales and deliver innovative fan experiences. We’re a remote-first team driven by core values - begin and build with trust, play like the underdog, win as a team, and do your thing. If you’re collaborative, adaptable, and eager to shape the future of live sports, Jump is the place for you. The Role Jump is seeking a Senior Data Engineer to join our nimble Data team, where you’ll help build and evolve the data platform that powers the company. You’ll own the reliability and performance of our Snowflake and dbt-powered stack, building the pipelines and models that make data trustworthy and usable across Jump - from internal dashboards to client-facing products. As we create and iterate on agentic functionality across our product, you’ll help shape how Jump builds on and leverages its data foundation. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role spanning data platform, analytics engineering, and data infrastructure. You’ll work across the stack, solving problems end-to-end while helping shape the architecture and data practices that will support Jump as we scale. What You’ll Do Build and maintain ELT pipelines that turn raw data into modular, well-tested dbt models inside Snowflake Design and maintain reliable data orchestration and workflows as the platform grows in complexity Write and maintain dbt tests that catch issues before they reach a critical point Document models and sources so the meaning of our data is discoverable Build monitoring and alerting that surfaces pipeline failures and data anomalies before anyone has to ask Optimize Snowflake table design and materialization strategy to keep performance high and costs in check as data volume grows Help evolve Snowflake access controls and governance, keeping roles, grants, and security aligned with organizational standards Dig into what internal teams and external clients actually need from our data, not just what they ask for Bring a strong engineering discipline to data work; version control, CI/CD, code review Build the data infrastructure and governance needed to support new AI/ML use cases, including reliable access to high-quality, well-understood data What We’re Looking For 6+ years of data engineering experience Ability to independently own complex data systems from design through production and make sound architectural tradeoffs Strong product and stakeholder instincts - you can translate ambiguous business needs into durable data solutions Deep, production-grade SQL and Snowflake expertise Deep experience with dbt, including testing, documentation, dependencies, and deployment Software engineering discipline — Git-based version control, CI/CD for data pipelines, and strong Python skills for building data pipelines, orchestration, and custom transformations A track record of building testing, monitoring, and alerting into pipelines before something breaks, not after Nice to Haves Familiarity with BI/analytics tools, ideally Sigma Experience with orchestration and workflow tooling Depth with cloud platforms Exposure to supporting ML/AI pipelines or streaming and real-time data Attributes that will make you successful on our team A strong desire to learn. You are curious and willing to dive deep to become a subject matter expert in our domain Tenacity. You enjoy working on challenges that others can’t or don’t want to tackle and you aren’t afraid of failing fast in order to find better solutions. Passion. You love using your skills to solve real problems. You hold yourself to a high standard and help to elevate others as well. Empathy. You thrive in an environment where everyone can truly be themselves. You understand that our differing life experiences influence who we are and how we show up, and these diverse perspectives enrich both our team and our product. Customer-centric mindset. You put customers at the heart of everything they do, striving to understand their needs and exceed their expectations Innovation: Passion for exploring and implementing AI technologies to enhance automation, optimize workflows, and drive innovation Benefits Remote first Competitive salary and equity Flex PTO policy 401(k) Generous medical, dental and vision plans 16 weeks paid parental leave for primary and secondary caregivers $1,000 reimbursement for work-from-home tech setup $1,000 reimbursement for learning and development Company-paid sustainability subscription to ensure carbon neutrality is maintained for employee activities, such as travel Compensation Compensation is something we don’t want our candidates or employees to worry about. Our goal is to offer competitive salaries that are regularly benchmarked against the market. The core tenants of our compensation philosophy are fairness and transparency. We have established a standardized leveling framework based on job scope and responsibilities. This means that every person at a certain level is paid the same as everyone else, regardless of their background, previous compensation, location, or any other factor. The compensation for this role is $190,000-$210,000 and includes a generous equity package. Application Some candidates may see the requirements and feel unsure that they match all the criteria.
