items.description: Design Headquarters: Egypt iSchool is an innovative and rapidly growing e-learning company that provides online coding and artificial intelligence education to students aged 6 to 18 years old. As a leading platform in the industry, we are committed to equipping the next generation with the skills they need to thrive in the digital era. We are currently seeking a dynamic and passionate individual to join our team as a Coding Instructor for a project-based position lasting 3 months. Overview We are seeking a Digital Arts Track Instructor responsible for delivering engaging, hands-on sessions that introduce students to the fundamentals of digital design, animation, video editing, and 3D content creation. The instructor will guide students through practical creative workflows using industry-relevant tools such as Photopea, Figma, Canva, Inkscape, CapCut, Blender, and Unity. The role focuses on helping students understand core visual design principles, animation fundamentals, and digital media production while encouraging creativity, problem-solving, and project-based learning. Key Responsibilities Deliver structured sessions covering digital design, animation, video editing, and 3D modeling fundamentals. Teach students how to use digital creative tools including Photopea, Figma, Canva, Inkscape, CapCut, Blender, and Unity. Guide students through hands-on projects such as designing logos, creating vector illustrations, producing short videos, and building simple 3D models. Introduce design principles including shape composition, layout, and visual storytelling. Teach students how to break complex drawings into simple geometric shapes and design creative visual assets. Explain core 2D animation concepts including animation basics, character joints, and shape-based animation techniques. Demonstrate how animation is used in games, cartoons, and digital media. Teach the fundamentals of video editing including trimming clips, arranging timelines, adding text overlays, and adjusting basic audio. Introduce students to 3D modeling concepts using Blender, including navigating the interface and creating simple low‑poly models. Explain the differences between Eevee and Cycles render engines and guide students in exporting visual outputs. Guide students in importing assets into Unity and organizing them for basic game development workflows. Mentor students during exercises and projects while encouraging creativity and experimentation. Strong understanding of digital design fundamentals , including composition, layout, and visual storytelling. Practical experience with digital creative tools , such as Photopea, Figma, Canva, Inkscape, CapCut, Blender, and Unity . Knowledge of vector illustration and digital design workflows . Understanding of 2D animation fundamentals , including shape-based animation and character joints. Basic knowledge of video editing , including timeline management, trimming clips, adding text overlays, and basic audio adjustments. Familiarity with 3D modeling concepts in Blender , including creating simple low-poly models. Basic understanding of render engines (Eevee and Cycles) and exporting visual outputs. Basic knowledge of game development workflows , including importing and organizing assets in Unity. Ability to explain complex creative concepts in a simple and engaging way . Experience in guiding students through practical, project-based learning activities . Strong communication, mentoring, and classroom engagement skills . Compatible Salary. Flexible Hours. Certificate of Experience Team Collaboration & Mentorship To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/ischool-graphic-design-instructor-project-based

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Canada URL: https://designfiles.co/ About the job: We're looking for a highly organized Content Marketing Coordinator to join our team on a remote contract basis. This role is ideal for someone who loves turning ideas into finished marketing campaigns. You'll write content, coordinate creative assets, keep projects moving, and make sure every email, social post, landing page, and product announcement is polished before it reaches our audience. We're not looking for flashy marketing copy. We're looking for someone who can communicate like a real human, who can write the way you'd talk to a designer over coffee: helpful, clear, and genuinely useful. If you're someone who notices the small details, enjoys keeping projects organized, and gets satisfaction from shipping great work, we'd love to hear from you. What you’ll help with: You'll work closely with our marketing and product teams to help bring campaigns to life by: Writing and editing marketing emails, newsletters, social posts, ads, landing pages, product updates, and promotional copy Turning campaign ideas, product launches, and feature updates into clear action plans, timelines, and deliverables Coordinating with designers to create graphics, creative assets, and revisions Gathering screenshots, product details, customer examples, links, and supporting materials needed for marketing projects Scheduling and publishing emails, social content, and other marketing updates Helping execute product launches, webinars, contests, promotions, and campaigns Reviewing marketing assets before they go live to ensure quality and accuracy Keeping marketing calendars, task lists, and project documentation organized and up to date Following up with team members to keep projects moving and deadlines on track What you’ll need: Excellent writing and editing skills Able to write marketing that feels like a helpful one-on-one conversation, not generic sales copy Strong understanding of audience, tone, and clear communication Exceptional organization and attention to detail (this is one of the most important parts of the role) Comfortable managing multiple projects at once without losing track of details Reliable follow-through and a bias toward getting things done Experience with email marketing, social media, content marketing, or campaign execution Bonus points: Experience working with SaaS companies Experience in the interior design industry or another creative field About us: DesignFiles is an all-in-one business platform built specifically for interior designers. Thousands of designers use DesignFiles to manage projects, collaborate with clients, create presentations, source products, and run more profitable businesses. Everything we create is designed to make designers' lives easier, and our marketing reflects that. We focus on education, practical advice, and helping designers succeed—not pushy sales tactics. Apply for the job: Love writing clear, helpful content and keeping marketing projects moving? Join DesignFiles as a remote Content Marketing Coordinator. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/designfiles-content-marketing-coordinator

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Canada - Remote Description de l'entreprise Workleap est une entreprise tech basée à Montréal avec comme mission de rendre le travail plus simple. Depuis 2006, on bâtit des produits innovants qui aident les équipes RH et TI à relever leurs plus grands défis. Workleap offre deux lignes de produits distinctes : La plateforme Workleap , une solution RH propulsée par l’IA qui élève la performance des équipes et stimule l’engagement des employés. ShareGate , le leader incontesté en migration et gouvernance Microsoft 365, reconnu par les professionnels TI du monde entier pour sa grande simplicité. Aujourd’hui, c’est plus de 20 000 entreprises partout dans le monde qui comptent sur les produits Workleap pour croître, évoluer et opérer. On est des bâtisseurs dans l’âme et ce qui nous passionne est clair : créer les produits les plus simples qui amènent de la valeur exceptionnelle à nos clients, un point c’est tout. Description du poste Concrètement à quoi va ressembler ton poste ? En tant que Senior Designer de Produit sur ShareGate Migrate , tu travailleras au sein d’un trio produit étroitement collaboratif (PM, Tech Lead, Designer) pour façonner l’expérience d’un produit utilisé dans des projets à fort impact et à forte sensibilité opérationnelle. Tu concevras des solutions qui aident les administrateurs TI à naviguer dans des scénarios de migration complexes avec clarté et confiance. Ton travail couvre à la fois la stratégie et l’exécution : définition des problématiques, conception des parcours et des interactions, affinage des détails d’interface, et itérations rapides basées sur les apprentissages. Tu exploreras de manière réfléchie comment l’ IA peut enrichir l’expérience, que ce soit pour simplifier la planification, faire émerger des insights pertinents ou guider les équipes dans leurs décisions techniques. C’est une occasion de travailler sur des enjeux concrets ayant un impact réel sur l’évolution des environnements numériques des organisations. Tu t’épanouiras dans ce rôle si tu aimes la complexité, collabores naturellement avec les ingénieurs et les PM, et accordes une grande importance à la création d’expériences utilisateur fiables, réfléchies et capables de passer à l’échelle. Responsabilités : Piloter le design de bout en bout au sein de ton équipe produit, de la définition des problèmes jusqu’au raffinement des interactions finales ; Transformer des parcours ambigus ou techniques en expériences intuitives et utiles pour des professionnels TI ; Concevoir des parcours, interfaces et interactions qui simplifient les scénarios de migration Microsoft 365 et cloud ; Collaborer étroitement avec les PM, les ingénieurs et les experts métier pour clarifier le périmètre et aligner la stratégie ; Prototyper, tester et itérer rapidement afin de valider les hypothèses et renforcer les solutions ; Utiliser les données, les retours clients et les insights produit pour guider les décisions et améliorer les résultats ; Explorer des opportunités liées à l’IA pour rendre les flux de migration et de gouvernance plus efficaces, prédictifs et fiables ; Contribuer à l’amélioration des pratiques design à l’aide de nouveaux outils, d’innovations et de nouvelles méthodologies ; Participer à l’évolution du design system et veiller à la cohérence de l’expérience à travers ShareGate. Une semaine typique? Tu évolueras naturellement entre exploration stratégique, design concret et collaboration étroite. Concrètement, tu pourras : Contribuer à la direction produit lors des activités de planification et de découverte en trio ; Traduire les besoins clients et les opportunités business en parcours clairs, wireframes et prototypes ; Travailler avec l’ingénierie pour affiner le périmètre, comprendre les contraintes et maintenir un haut niveau de qualité design tout au long du développement ; Présenter des travaux en cours aux équipes et aux parties prenantes lors de critiques ou de revues asynchrones ; Analyser les données de migration, les tendances de support et les comportements utilisateurs pour éclairer les décisions ; Raffiner les détails d’interaction et assurer des hand-offs clairs et cohérents ; Documenter les décisions et communiquer efficacement le raisonnement derrière les choix effectués ; Utiliser des outils d’IA pour mieux comprendre nos utilisateurs et augmenter ton efficacité ; Prototyper régulièrement avec des outils de prototypage assistés par l’IA pour communiquer, tester et valider les solutions. Tu bénéficieras d’autonomie, de responsabilité, et d’une équipe qui valorise l’exécution réfléchie et l’apprentissage continu. Qui est l’équipe que tu vas rejoindre ? Tu rejoindras une équipe multidisciplinaire où les designers sont impliqués tôt, influencent la direction produit et collaborent étroitement avec l’ingénierie et la gestion de produit. Le design chez Workleap est collaboratif, riche en feedback, et engagé à constamment élever le niveau, autant dans les processus que dans la qualité du craft. Quels sont les prochains défis qui attendent ton équipe ? ShareGate évolue rapidement, et les défis design à venir demandent à la fois créativité et rigueur. Tu contribueras notamment à : Des scénarios de migration à l’échelle entreprise, où la clarté, la prévisibilité et l’efficacité sont essentielles ; La modernisation des expériences clés de ShareGate Migrate et de l’écosystème plus large ; L’évolution d’un design system en croissance, soutenant de nouveaux patterns, l’accessibilité et la cohérence multi-produits ; Des expériences de planification et de guidance AI-native pour aider les équipes TI à anticiper les risques et prendre des décisions éclairées. C’est un rôle où tu peux influencer non seulement le fonctionnement du produit aujourd’hui, mais aussi son évolution sur les prochaines années. Qualifications 6+ ans d’expérience en design de produits B2B SaaS au sein d’équipes multidisciplinaires ; Fort sens de l’utilisateur et aisance dans des environnements ambigus et techniquement complexes ; Maîtrise de la stratégie, des parcours UX, du design UI et des détails d’interaction soignés ; Capacité à trouver l’équilibre entre rapidité d’exécution et haute qualité ; Expérience auprès d’audiences techniques (TI, outils d’administration, plateformes) — un atout ; Expérience en conception ou collaboration sur des fonctionnalités propulsées par l’IA ; Excellentes compétences en communication et en storytelling ; Grand souci du détail et engagement fort envers la qualité du design. Fourchette salariale : 120–145 k $ CAD. La fourchette salariale affichée reflète notre échelle de rémunération au Canada. Au moment de formuler une offre, selon la région où le candidat est basé, certains ajustements peuvent s’appliquer afin de refléter les conditions du marché local. Qui nous sommes On est une équipe de curieux et de créateurs passionnés, rassemblés par le même objectif : rendre le travail plus simple - et meilleur - pour tout le monde. Les défis stimulent notre créativité, on carbure à l'intensité, et repousser les limites fait partie de notre ADN. On pense que les meilleures idées naissent de l’expérimentation, de l’apprentissage continu, et parfois même de l’inconfort—c’est comme ça qu’on évolue. Depuis 2006, on réinvente la façon dont les équipes travaillent, en alliant créativité et technologie pour résoudre de vrais problèmes en TI et en RH. On avance vite, on apprend constamment, et on garde toujours nos clients au coeur de nos décisions. Si tu es une personne proactive, qui prend les choses en main, adore collaborer et n’a pas peur de plonger dans l’inconnu - tu trouveras parfaitement ta place parmi nous. Informations supplémentaires Chez Workleap, on bâtit ensemble, on se fait confiance et on se soutient, dans la réussite ou dans l'échec. Tu pourras t'exprimer, évoluer et développer ta créativité dans un environnement qui s'adaptera à ton quotidien et à tes besoins. Nos aspirations sont de bâtir un environnement de travail sain et inclusif. Il s’agit là de l’affaire de tous et de toutes. Notre processus Expérience Candidat chez Workleap : Entrevue téléphonique - Entrevue virtuelle par Teams - Mise en situation - Offre d'emploi En tant qu’entreprise technologique, nous utilisons l’IA pour optimiser le recrutement, tout en veillant à ce que toutes les décisions d’évaluation restent humaines. On a hâte d'apprendre à te connaître ! En postulant à ce poste, tu confirmes avoir lu et être en accord avec notre politique de confidentialité . #LI-Remote To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/sharegate-migrate-chezworkleap-senior-product-designer-sharegate-migrate

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Canada Rockstar is recruiting for a digital product studio that specializes in turning ideas into extraordinary digital experiences. This client is a dynamic, remote-first team of savvy professionals known for pushing creative boundaries and delivering high-quality, user-centered products through a collaborative and lean approach. This client is building a bench of talented product designers for upcoming client work. They are looking for mid-to-senior-level freelance designers who can bring strong UX thinking, sharp visual design skills, and a collaborative spirit to the team. What they're looking for If you're a seasoned product designer with a passion for digital excellence, this opportunity is for you. You’ve honed your craft over the years, with a deep understanding of UX design, visual storytelling, and collaborative product development. You’re equally comfortable working independently and alongside a cross-functional team. You manage your time well, take ownership of your work, and make confident decisions with minimal oversight. You’re fluent in tools like Figma and Adobe Suite, and you bring a user-first mindset to everything you do — whether designing mobile apps or contributing to product strategy. If you're the type of designer who pushes creative boundaries, communicates clearly, and still knows how to have a little fun in the process — they’d love to hear from you. The Details As a Product Design Contractor, you’ll contribute to a range of client-facing projects, collaborating with the Chief Creative Officer and team across the following areas: - Digital Product Design (Web & App): Shape intuitive experiences by applying research, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs that elevate functionality and user engagement. - User Research & Discovery: Conduct qualitative and quantitative research to inform feature planning and prioritization. Help build products grounded in real user needs and business goals. - User Experience (UX): Apply UX methodologies like journey mapping, user flows, and usability testing to define products beyond UI — ensuring seamless and strategic user experiences. - Visual Design: Lead visual direction on select projects, producing compelling layouts and assets that translate beautifully across platforms — from product to marketing. - Presentation Collateral: Design high-impact presentation decks and visuals that bring ideas to life for clients and stakeholders. - Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with engineering and product teams by providing annotated designs, QA support, and input during handoff and development. - Additional Design Support: Contribute to project-related needs like case studies, marketing assets, and content design for social media or internal documentation. Qualifications - 4–6 years of experience in product and visual design, with a strong focus on digital experiences across web and/or mobile - Solid understanding of UX principles, including user research, usability testing, and translating insights into design decisions - Demonstrated ability to own features or tracks of work with minimal oversight — from wireframes to high-fidelity execution - Comfortable leading or contributing to discovery phases and helping define product direction in collaboration with strategy and engineering - Proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite, with experience working in a Mac environment - Familiarity with remote collaboration tools such as Google Suite, Slack, Zoom, Jira, and Harvest - Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a team-first mindset and the ability to clearly articulate design rationale - Organized, proactive, and able to manage your own time in a fast-paced, remote work environment - Bonus: experience working in client-facing or agency settings where flexibility, autonomy, and cross-functional teamwork are key What to Expect from the Process This is a contract-based role and part of an ongoing effort to build relationships with experienced designers for future client projects. items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Remote (Within 3 hours of EST timezone preferred) What excites you You want to be early. You like being close to the product, the customer, and the messiness of figuring things out. You enjoy turning sharp customer insight into positioning that actually changes behavior. You care about story-telling. You want to build narratives from launches and words to be thoughtful and useful, not generic or AI slop. You’re energized by hospitality. Hotels are complex, human, and operationally intense. That makes the work interesting, particularly in an age of AI. You want real ownership. If something ships poorly, you fix it. If something lands well, you know exactly why. What excites us You’ve spent 5–7 years in product marketing at a high-growth company, ideally B2B SaaS or complex marketplaces. You can explain technical or operational products in a way that feels simple and grounded. You’ve owned messaging and positioning end to end in close partnership with product, sales, and leadership. You’ve rewritten it when it didn’t work. You’ve led go-to-market for real products, not just features. You know how to scope a launch, make tradeoffs, and ship. You care to measure impact post-launch. You’re not precious about what “typical” PMMs look like. You like wearing different hats and can go beyond product marketing to engage contractors for events planning, or work with an agency to test some ads, when needed. You’re comfortable going deep. Customer calls, sales calls, demos, win-loss. You look for signal, not anecdotes. You’re hands-on. You write the first draft. You build the deck. You partner with design, but you don’t wait on them. Bonus if you’ve worked in hospitality, travel, fintech, or vertical SaaS. Bigger bonus if you genuinely like hotels. Working at Folio We're a remote-first company. Three times a year, we travel to work together in-person and stay with one of our hotel partners. We love experimenting with new tools. For the most part, we rely on Google Meet, Linear, Notion, and Slack to make decisions and get things done day-to-day. You will have the opportunity to travel frequently and meet our customers in person at conferences and events, which you will be helping plan for. We're a small team who work collaboratively and meet daily for stand up What we value Craft . We take pride in our work, find joy in execution, and believe that the best companies are built at a steady yet resilient pace. Optimism . We believe in ourselves and each other and know anything is possible with the right amount of hustle and grit. Ownership . We love making things better and have a strong sense of shared responsibility over everything we create together. Hospitality. The industry we’re building for has a culture of service to others, and we bring that energy to how we work together each day. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/folio-product-marketing-manager

items.description: Design Headquarters: worldwide URL: http://www.brfood.us Senior Remote Team Leader — Accounting, Data & Operations Food Services Inc. — Wholesale meat and restaurant supply distributor based in Los Angeles, California Remote Contractor Position Compensation Starting base compensation: $2,500 USD per month This position includes opportunities for: * Performance bonuses * Responsibility-based increases * Leadership increases * Additional compensation for taking ownership of major business functions A strong performer can grow the base compensation to approximately $3,000 per month within the first year, in addition to applicable performance bonuses. Compensation growth will be based on measurable responsibility, performance, accuracy, leadership, and the ability to independently manage important areas of the business. About the Role: We are looking for a senior-level Accounting & Operations Team Leader who can take ownership of daily workflows, work independently, review the work of others, and turn business data into clear actions and decisions. This is not a basic data-entry position. We are looking for someone who can operate at a top 10% performance level — someone who can analyze, review, identify problems, follow up, and help improve the way the team works. The right person should be comfortable managing both people and data in a fast-moving business environment. Key Responsibilities You will be responsible for helping lead and review daily accounting and operational workflows, including: * Reviewing and analyzing large amounts of business and financial data * Identifying errors, discrepancies, trends, and opportunities * Reviewing team members’ work for accuracy and completion * Purchase Order vs. Vendor Bill analysis * Vendor pricing and quantity discrepancy review * Accounts receivable and customer aging * Vendor aging and accounts payable * Inventory analysis and reconciliation * Price updates and vendor price-list comparisons * Creating and improving Excel reports and tracking systems * Following up on unresolved issues until they are completed * Helping organize team priorities and daily workflow * Communicating clearly with management and team members * Using AI and automation to reduce repetitive work and improve accuracy * Developing better processes, controls, and reporting systems We want someone who does more than complete a task. We expect you to understand the task, review the results, identify what is wrong, and recommend the next action. Required Experience Strong candidates should have professional experience with: * QuickBooks * Microsoft Excel — advanced level * Financial data reconciliation * Data analysis and reporting * Purchase orders and vendor bills * Accounts payable and/or accounts receivable * Reviewing and auditing work for accuracy * Managing multiple priorities * Team leadership or senior-level responsibility * Strong written and spoken English You must also be comfortable working daily with: * Zoom * ClickUp * QuickBooks * Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets * Remote desktop and cloud-based systems AI & Automation Experience We are especially interested in candidates who already understand how to use modern technology to improve their work. Experience with any of the following is highly valued: * ChatGPT or other AI tools * AI-assisted data analysis * Workflow automation * Excel automation * Macros * Automated reporting * Process improvement * Building repeatable systems and procedures You do not need to be a programmer, but you should understand how AI and automation can help a business work faster, more accurately, and with fewer manual steps. Leadership Expectations This is a Team Leader role. You should be able to: * Take ownership without waiting for constant instructions * Review other team members’ work * Identify mistakes before they become larger problems * Prioritize tasks based on business importance * Communicate problems clearly * Follow up until issues are resolved * Train and guide junior team members * Keep management updated with meaningful information * Separate urgent issues from routine tasks * Look for opportunities to improve existing processes We are looking for someone who asks: “What does this data tell us, what is the problem, and what action should we take?” —not simply: “What task should I do next?” Work Schedule Monday through Saturday 8-hour shift per day The position operates according to Pacific Time (Los Angeles), and candidates must be able to work consistently within the assigned schedule. Because this is a remote leadership position, reliability, attendance, responsiveness, and availability during working hours are extremely important. Equipment Requirements You must have a professional remote-work setup capable of supporting all-day Zoom, QuickBooks, remote-hosted environments, Excel, ClickUp, and other business applications simultaneously. Required: * Business-class laptop or desktop * Intel Core i7 / AMD Ryzen 7 or equivalent * 32GB RAM minimum * 1TB NVMe SSD preferred * Dual monitors * Reliable high-speed internet * Wired Ethernet strongly preferred * Quiet and professional workspace Candidate Assessment Before moving forward, qualified candidates will complete a practical assessment. The workbook contains: Sheet 1 — Purchase Order Sheet 2 — Vendor Bill Your assignment is to analyze the two documents and identify the differences, discrepancies, and anything else you believe management should know. Assessment workbook: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1H2UFgxxF1DbBJvoYJFNCnyGY_WsRKqvU/edit?gid=1320818024#gid=1320818024 Assessment Rules 1. Do not delete or modify the original sheets. 2. Preserve all original sheets for audit purposes. 3. Do not convert formulas to values. 4. Your workbook must remain fully auditable. 5. Show your analysis, calculations, and logic inside the Excel file. 6. Do not simply identify differences — demonstrate how you think about the business impact and what should be reviewed or followed up on. How to Apply Email your completed assessment workbook in .xlsx format to: assessments.brfoodus@gmail.com Subject: Assessment Attach the completed Excel file. We are looking for candidates who can demonstrate accuracy, analytical thinking, ownership, leadership, and strong business judgment through their work. Food Services Inc. Los Angeles, California https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1H2UFgxxF1DbBJvoYJFNCnyGY_WsRKqvU/edit?gid=1320818024#gid=1320818024 To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/food-service-specialties-back-office-support-1

items.description: Design Headquarters: Dire Dawa, Ethiopia URL: http://iisd.org Background The Scaling Urban Nature-based Solutions (NbS) for Climate Adaptation in Sub-Saharan Africa (SUNCASA) is a 3-year project aiming at enhancing climate resilience and promoting gender equality, social inclusion, and biodiversity protection across three cities: Dire Dawa (Ethiopia), Kigali (Rwanda) and Johannesburg (South Africa). Led by the International Institute for Sustainable Development and the World Resources Institute, and implemented in partnership with local organizations and communities, SUNCASA seeks to address climate change impacts—such as floods, landslides, and soil erosion—through gender-responsive and socially inclusive NbS. These include afforestation, reforestation, agroforestry, urban greening, the removal of invasive alien species, and the creation of vegetated buffer zones in flood-prone areas. Entering its third and final year of the current implementation phase, SUNCASA is already achieving significant results, generating measurable adaptation outcomes and strengthening the resilience of communities and landscapes across its project sites. To sustain these achievements beyond the project time frame, SUNCASA is investing in building local ownership and stewardship, with a particular emphasis on engaging children and youth as future custodians of their environments. For more information, visit www.suncasa.org . As part of this effort, SUNCASA is developing a series of four animated videos, with stories and scripts co-created alongside local partners to ensure they reflect community realities, priorities, and cultural contexts. Through engaging storytelling and accessible messages, the animations will encourage young audiences to understand the importance of protecting local ecosystems and livelihoods, recognize their role in sustaining climate adaptation efforts, and contribute to building more resilient and sustainable communities. Purpose of the Consultancy Within the framework of SUNCASA’s Communications Strategy, IISD is seeking an experienced animator or animation studio to conceptualize, design, and produce a series of three animated videos showcasing the project's NbS impacts and highlighting the role of local youth in sustaining these achievements across SUNCASA's three project cities. A fourth animation will focus on promoting the project's gender equality and social inclusion (GESI) approach. Working closely with SUNCASA's Communications team and representatives from the project's local partners, the consultant will be responsible for translating existing scripts into engaging visual narratives through the development of high-quality animations of approximately 2–2.5 minutes each. The videos should communicate the project's approach, results, and impact in a way that is compelling, accessible, and suitable for diverse audiences, with a particular focus on young people. Animations and supporting illustrations must be designed on Adobe Creative Cloud software—After Effects, Illustrator, and InDesign. SUNCASA will provide relevant reference materials—including photographs, videos, project documentation, and brand assets—to inform the visual concept, character design, and storytelling. The animations will be based on scripts co-created with local partners to ensure they authentically reflect the social, cultural, and environmental contexts of each project location. The consultant will be expected to develop a distinctive visual style that resonates with local audiences while maintaining consistency across the animation series. The animations are expected to be developed primarily in English. The SUNCASA Communications team will provide all voiceover and dialogue recordings, including versions in local languages such as Amharic, Afaan Oromo, and Kinyarwanda, which the consultant will integrate into the final productions. The assignment covers the full animation production process, including visual concept development, character and environment design, storyboarding, illustration, animation, editing, and post-production. Final deliverables will include landscape and portrait versions of each animation, optimized for web, social media, and mobile platforms. The consultant will also provide all editable source files—including artwork, illustrations, animation assets, and project files—to allow future adaptation and reuse by the SUNCASA Communications team. The completed animations will support educational and awareness-raising activities led by SUNCASA’s local partners, particularly among children and youth. They will also be disseminated through community WhatsApp and Telegram groups and promoted through SUNCASA’s and partners’ websites and social media channels, helping to expand outreach, strengthen engagement, and reinforce the long-term sustainability of project outcomes. Objectives of the Consultancy General Objective The overall objective of this consultancy is to design and produce a series of four short, animated videos that communicate the achievements and impacts of the SUNCASA project in an engaging and accessible way. This includes three animations highlighting the project’s NbS interventions and their contribution to community and ecosystem resilience across three cities, while one will focus on SUNCASA’s GESI approach. The animations aim to strengthen local ownership and long-term sustainability of project results by engaging children and youth as key audiences. Through culturally relevant storytelling co-developed with local partners, the animations should inspire behavioural change and reinforce the role of youth as key agents of resilience and environmental stewardship. The final products will serve as adaptable communication tools for community outreach, education, and broader dissemination through digital platforms and partner networks. Specific Objectives To design and produce four high-quality animated videos (approximately 2–2.5 minutes each) that communicate SUNCASA’s results, impacts, and approaches in an engaging, accessible, and visually compelling format, particularly to younger audiences. To develop three animations showcasing SUNCASA’s NbS interventions and their contribution to strengthening the resilience of communities and ecosystems across the project’s three cities. To produce one animation highlighting SUNCASA’s GESI approach and its role in promoting inclusive and equitable climate adaptation outcomes. To lead the full animation production process, including visual concept development, character and environment design, storyboarding, illustration, animation, editing, and post-production, in close collaboration with SUNCASA’s Communications team and local partners. To deliver final outputs in both landscape and portrait formats, as well as short versions of each video optimized for social media, along with all editable source files (including artwork, illustrations, animation assets, and project files) to enable future adaptation and reuse by the SUNCASA Communications team. Tasks and Deliverables The consultant will be responsible for leading the full animation production process as outlined below: Activity 1: Inception and Creative Development Review all aesthetics and visual reference materials provided by SUNCASA. Participate in a kickoff meeting with the SUNCASA Communications teams and representatives of the local partner organizations. Develop a creative concept and visual approach aligned with SUNCASA branding and the visual references provided. Prepare a detailed production plan and timeline, including at least three rounds of feedback and the platform on which concepts and drafts will be shared for review. Deliverable 1 : Detailed work plan, including time frame; Creative concept with animation style and visual approach. Activity 2: Storyboards - Based on the co-created scripts provided by the SUNCASA Communications team and informed by the approved creative concept, the consultant will design individual storyboards for each animation. Deliverable 2 : Individual storyboards for each video, with a detailed description of each sequence and scene. Activity 3 : Initial Video Drafts - Following the scripts provided by the SUNCASA Comms team and the approved storyboard, the consultant will develop initial versions of all four animations with no audio and submit them for review. Based on feedback, the updated versions will be created and submitted for approval. - Drafts should include motion graphics, character animations, as well as maps and geographic visualization where applicable. Deliverable 3 : The initial and updated cut of each video animation draft with no audio, including the feedback provided by the team. Activity 4: Final versions of all four animated videos in English and integration of voiceover, dialogues in local languages, as well as soundtrack; create cut-down social media cuts - The consultant will use the approved versions to integrate the voiceover, dialogues, and soundtrack into each animation. - In addition to English, one animation will have a version in Kinyarwanda; and one will have versions in Amharic and Afaan Oromo—translations to be provided by the SUNCASA Communications team. - An additional round of feedback will be required at this stage before approval of the final versions. - In addition to the full animations, the consultant will deliver a cut-down version (30 to 45 seconds) of each video, optimized for social media. Deliverable 4 : A final version of each animation in English with voiceover, dialogues, and soundtrack in local languages, as applicable. A cut-down version of each animation for social media. Activity 5: Submit all editable source files (including artwork, illustrations, animation assets, and project files) - Organize, name, and share all working files, including artwork, illustrations, animation assets, and project files. Deliverable 5 : A folder with all required assets to be shared with the SUNCASA Communications team. Read the full Terms of Reference here for Reporting, Evaluation and Selection Criteria. Consultancy for the Design and Production of Four Animated Videos Showcasing SUNCASA’s Achievements and Inspiring Youth Engagement in Sustaining Project Results Application deadline: August 3, 2026 Application Process All applications must be submitted in English. To apply for this consultancy, please send: Cover Letter outlining relevant professional experience of proposed consultant(s). Please include the name and contact details of the primary contact person. Detailed resume of proposed consultant(s) highlighting relevant experience in all stages of animation production, from creative concept to post-production. Technical Proposal outlining understanding of the assignment and how the consultant(s) plan to undertake the project, including a proposed work plan and timeline. The proposed work plan must align with the deliverables and timeline set out in Sections 4 and 5. Portfolio with at least three examples of relevant animation videos. Please indicate the links to the videos in the technical proposal. Financial Proposal that includes the consultant’s daily rate and any additional costs associated with this assignment, with all costs clearly broken down and aligned to each deliverable and key activities outlined in the Scope of Work. Financial proposals must be aligned with the scope described in Section 5 of this RFP. At least two (2) references from previous related projects. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/iisd-consultancy-for-the-design-and-production-of-four-animated-videos-showcasing-suncasa-s-achievements-and

items.description: Design Headquarters: Kaupmehe 7 Tallinn, 10114 Estonia URL: http://ilogos.biz iLogos Game Studios provides solutions for mobile game developers no matter how challenging the project or task is. We’ve been around since 2006 and in that time frame, we have successfully completed 400+ projects and have become a partner of choice for EA, Sony, Disney, Rovio, Ubisoft, and many other companies. What We're Looking For We're looking for more than just an artist—we're looking for a character designer capable of creating memorable, visually compelling characters that feel like an integral part of the game world. The ideal candidate understands how to build characters with personality, backstory, and a strong visual identity while ensuring the designs translate efficiently into 3D production and animation. About the Project We are looking for an experienced 2D Character Concept Artist to create the key characters for a new game project. The project's setting blends science fiction, cyberpunk, a utopian world, and grounded atmospheric realism. References for the desired mood and level of quality include Death Stranding, Cyberpunk 2077, and modern AAA RPGs. Your primary responsibility will be to create a unique visual identity for a character that will serve as the foundation for 3D modeling, rigging, animation, and in-game implementation. Responsibilities Develop the visual concept of a character based on a creative brief. Research and collect relevant visual references. Create multiple concept directions and design variations. Design and refine the character's silhouette, proportions, outfit, equipment, accessories, and overall visual language. Produce a high-quality final character concept. Prepare production-ready materials for the 3D team. Create turnaround sheets (front, side, and back views). Prepare detailed callout sheets for clothing, materials, equipment, and structural elements. Collaborate with the Art Director to refine the character's artistic direction. Implement revisions based on feedback and review sessions. Expected Deliverables The final package should include all assets required for 3D production: Final approved character design. Fully rendered color concept. Character Sheet. Turnaround (Front / Side / Back). Detailed callout sheets for key design elements. Material and texture references. Layered PSD files with a well-organized layer structure. Requirements Proven experience as a Concept Artist or Character Designer in the game industry. Strong understanding of character design principles. Solid knowledge of human anatomy. Ability to work in both realistic and semi-realistic art styles. Experience creating production-ready designs suitable for 3D pipelines. Proficiency in Photoshop, Procreate, or equivalent software. Good understanding of the full game character production pipeline. A strong portfolio featuring characters for games, films, or AAA productions. Nice to Have Experience designing characters for sci-fi, cyberpunk, or post-apocalyptic settings. Understanding of 3D character modeling and animation workflows. Experience using AI tools during research and visual exploration. Experience collaborating with outsourcing teams and game studios. Working conditions: Our people are what we value the most at iLogos. We treat everyone with respect no matter where you are from or what you believe in. If you share our values which are Mastery, Maturity, Trust & Care, and Positive Mindset – we are a perfect match for each other! Join #ilogos_team and we guarantee you an opportunity for growth, support, and an atmosphere of trust and care that feels more like a family. And as well: Work remotely from anywhere in the world. Flexible working hours. Contract duration: approximately 3 months , with the possibility of extension based on project needs and mutual agreement. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/ilogos-2d-character-concept-artist

items.description: BDR Manager Sales | Reports to VP of Sales | Building the BDR function from zero Location: Remote (US-based) | Full-Time THE ROLE Grace Hill is building a BDR function from the ground up, and we are looking for the person who wants to own it. There is a thin playbook to inherit here, you will write it. You will hire reps, configure the tooling, define what a qualified opportunity looks like, and improve the model to scale it. This is a builder’s job with an operator’s discipline. You will manage 3–6 BDRs within your first year and be measured on the pipeline they create. WHAT YOU WILL OWN The playbook • Build targeting, personas, segmentation, sequences, cadences, and qualification criteria from scratch — then document them so a new hire can run the motion in week two. • Define the handoff: what qualifies, what gets rejected, and what Sales can expect on every opportunity. • Run a real test-and-learn loop. Ship a change, measure it, keep it or kill it. The playbook should look different in month six than it did in month one. Pipeline • Own the team’s pipeline number and hit it. Work backward from AE coverage requirements to set volume and quality targets per rep. • Watch activity, connect rates, meeting-set rates, and downstream conversion — and act on the leading indicators before the lagging ones go red. • Report weekly on pipeline by source, stage, and rep, with a point of view on what the numbers mean. Operating rigor • Set and enforce data standards — stage definitions, field hygiene, naming conventions — so the reporting can be trusted. • Run the cadence: daily huddle, weekly 1:1s grounded in the rep’s own numbers, monthly business review. • Build the dashboards yourself. If you need someone else to pull your numbers, this role will frustrate you. The team • Hire, onboard, coach, and develop 3–6 BDRs. Give direct, specific, usable feedback. • Lead from the front — model behavior, get on calls, and show what good looks like rather than describing it. The stack • Own configuration, adoption, and enablement across Salesforce, a sales engagement platform, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Gong, Common Room, and ZoomInfo. • Use Gong to coach against what reps actually said, Common Room to surface intent and warm signals, and ZoomInfo to build and enrich the target universe. • Put AI to work on research, personalization, and list-building — and be honest about where it helps and where it produces noise. Partnership • Align with Sales on lead quality and handoff, and close the loop on what converts. • Partner with Marketing on outbound and ABM campaigns; bring the field evidence that sharpens targeting and messaging. WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR • Outbound experience — 3+ years as a BDR or SDR in B2B SaaS, plus at least a 2+ years leading a team. • An operator’s mind — You design systems, document them, and enforce them. You are comfortable in a spreadsheet and you think good process is what makes coaching possible. • Builder instinct — You would rather own something unfinished than inherit something polished. You are resourceful when the tools and budget are not perfect yet. • AI/Stack fluency — Hands-on with Salesforce reporting and forecasting, a sales engagement platform, Gong, Common Room, and ZoomInfo — and eager to pick up whatever comes next. Experimentation with AI in inbound/outbound playbooks. • Data Driven Decision Maker— You find the trend, explain it, and adjust the plan because of it. • Genuine coach — Developing talent is the part of the job you are most passionate about. BDRs serve as our Sales talent engine. • Ownership — You have a massive responsibility to the company’s success. • Student of the game — You are actively learning from peers, operators, and your own experiments and iterating it back to the team. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN YEAR ONE • Playbook built, documented, and consistently executed by the team. • Stack implemented and genuinely adopted. • Pipeline targets set, met, and forecastable, with conversion metrics trending in the right direction. • Reporting cadence running on its own; leadership trusts the numbers. • Reps measurably better than the day they started, with coaching impact visible in their metrics. • Sales and Marketing describing the BDR team as a source of quality pipeline, not just volume. WHAT WE OFFER Real ownership of a function you get to define, with the autonomy to build it your way. A leadership team that values operational rigor and will fund the tools to support it. Competitive base plus incentive tied to pipeline and team attainment. Room to grow as the revenue organization scales. Salary range: OTE of $160,000-$175,000 Grace Hill offers a robust suite of benefits, including health, dental and vision insurance, 401K, PTO, life insurance, disability insurance, and more. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Applicants must be based in the US and authorized to work in the US at the time of hire. About Us: Grace Hill provides industry-leading SaaS technology solutions designed to make a positive impact in real estate and improve the lives of people where they work and live. Harnessing years of real estate experience and the understanding that people are better together, Grace Hill helps owners and operators increase property performance, reduce operating risk and grow top talent. More than 500,000 professionals from over 1,700 companies rely on Grace Hill’s talent performance solutions covering policy, training, assessment, survey, and data-driven insights. Visit us at gracehill.com

items.description: Follow your passion Are you looking to make a BIG impact? At Zeta, we pursue an unprecedented combination of high academic achievement and social-emotional development for our students. We insist that every student receives a world-class education while fostering a love for learning. We are passionate about changing the landscape of public education in New York City and beyond, and we are uncompromising in our mission. Currently, we operate elementary, middle, and high schools in the Bronx, Upper Manhattan, and Queens . We plan to grow and open 1-2 schools each year because children in every community deserve excellent, equitable education. Our Network office is located at 401 W. 218th St., New York, NY 10034. Consultants will collaborate remotely or in-person as agreed upon based on project needs. Deliver powerful results To achieve our vision, we are searching for a Middle School Math Curriculum Writer Consultant with a Bachelor’s degree, Master’s degree preferred, and at least three years of experience designing and/or teaching high-quality secondary math instruction, with a proven record of developing rigorous, engaging, and culturally responsive curriculum. Project Scope & Responsibilities: Design full-course curricula for middle school science subjects (e.g., Statistics, Geometry, Pre-Algebra, Algebra 1) including scope and sequence, unit plans, and daily lesson plans Develop high-quality instructional materials, including: Student-facing lessons and problem sets Labs, projects, and real-world applications High-quality homework aligned with the course Formative and summative assessments with clear success criteria Ensure alignment to New York State standards and Zeta’s academic vision and outcomes Embed inquiry-based learning, conceptual understanding, and opportunities for analytical thinking and problem-solving Design assessments that measure both content mastery and application of skills Collaborate closely with academic leaders, instructional coaches, and other curriculum writers to ensure coherence across courses and grade levels Use feedback from educators and student performance data to iterate and improve curriculum materials Engagement & Compensation We are hiring for a 12 month project-based consulting role with an immediate start date. If selected, this role would be offered as a 1099 independent contractor engagement and would not constitute an offer of employment. Compensation: Between $15,000 and $25,000 per project unit (depending on experience and project scope) Consultants are responsible for their own taxes; consultants are not eligible for Zeta benefit plans. Work schedule is flexible; deliverables and deadlines will be agreed upon with the designated project lead. Join our purpose-driven community Zeta collaborators are lifelong learners who live with child-like joy and a deep sense of purpose. We disrupt the status quo and tackle problems together. Our network of consultants stands united by a commitment to a limitless future for every child. At Zeta: We are passionate about our mission of providing world-class education to all students We bring a mindset of growth and flexibility We are hungry and determined to not only meet our goals, but surpass them We are humble, willing to put the team’s needs ahead of our own, and committed to contributing to a collaborative work environment We have a high bar for excellence and sweat over the details We are caring and put team over individual at all times Apply Now! Equity is at the heart of our mission. We have a deep commitment to pursuing diversity and striving for equity. Zeta is an equal opportunity organization. Candidates of all backgrounds are encouraged to apply. Work authorization is required (candidate must have permanent authorization to work in the U.S.).

items.title: Medical Science Liaison/Senior Medical Science Liaison – (Ohio Valley) at Kyverna Therapeutics
items.summary: Kyverna Therapeutics is a patient-centered, clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing cell therapies for patients suffering from autoimmune diseases. Guided by our core values, Stay True to Why, Collaborate to Accelerate, Lead with Clarity, Boldly Innovative, and Own the Outcome, we are committed to transforming the future of treatment fo
items.description: Kyverna Therapeutics is a patient-centered, clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing cell therapies for patients suffering from autoimmune diseases. Guided by our core values, Stay True to Why, Collaborate to Accelerate, Lead with Clarity, Boldly Innovative, and Own the Outcome, we are committed to transforming the future of treatment for autoimmune disease. Join us at the forefront of cell therapy innovation and help redefine what’s possible. Position Overview Kyverna is seeking Medical Science Liaison (MSL)/Senior Medical Science Liaison (MSL) to join the Medical Affairs organization. The MSL will serve as a field-based scientific expert supporting external engagement with healthcare professionals, investigators, treatment centers, and key opinion leaders (KOLs) focused on autoimmune diseases and cell therapy. The ideal candidate will bring strong scientific expertise, exceptional relationship-building skills, and experience supporting complex specialty therapies within biotechnology or pharmaceutical environments. This individual will play a critical role in communicating scientific and clinical data, gathering field insights, and supporting the continued development of Kyverna’s CAR-T therapy programs. Location: Remote ideally based MI, OH, Western PA, Upstate NY, KY Travel: Approximately 50-70% Responsibilities Scientific Engagement & KOL Management Identify, establish, and maintain high‑quality scientific relationships with key opinion leaders (KOLs), investigators, academic medical centers, community physicians, pharmacists, nurses, and treatment centers within the assigned territory. Serve as a trusted scientific partner by providing fair‑balanced, accurate, and compliant scientific exchange related to disease state, treatment landscape, Kyverna’s CAR‑T programs, and emerging clinical data. Act as a primary scientific liaison to investigators interested in clinical research collaborations and investigator‑initiated research discussions, in alignment with company policies. Territory Strategy & Field Medical Planning Develop and execute geography‑specific Medical Affairs and KOL engagement plans aligned with therapeutic area objectives, investigator needs, and Kyverna’s medical strategy. Demonstrate ownership of the assigned territory through stakeholder mapping, prioritization, and proactive planning to influence the patient journey and support optimal therapeutic decision‑making. Partner with other Kyverna field medical colleagues to share insights and coordinate external engagement approaches where appropriate. Clinical Development & Trial Support Collaborate with Clinical Development and Clinical Operations colleagues to support Kyverna‑sponsored clinical trials, including: Identification of potential trial sites Engagement with participating investigators Support of trial awareness and scientific dialogue Contribute to efforts aimed at enhancing trial feasibility and enrollment through appropriate scientific engagement with investigators and treatment centers. Medical Insights & Internal Collaboration Capture and communicate timely, high‑quality medical insights related to the autoimmune and cell therapy landscape to internal stakeholders to support strategy and evidence planning. Translate external scientific perspectives into actionable insights that inform medical, clinical, and development decision‑making. Collaborate cross‑functionally with Clinical Development, Clinical Operations, Regulatory Affairs, Commercial, Market Access, and Patient Services teams while maintaining strict non‑promotional boundaries. Scientific Representation & Compliance Provide scientific support at national, regional, and local congresses, advisory boards, investigator meetings, and medical education forums. Respond compliantly to unsolicited medical information requests and serve as an internal and external scientific resource. Maintain current knowledge of therapeutic areas, treatment guidelines, clinical research processes, and cell therapy operational considerations, including treatment center workflows where applicable. Ensure timely completion of CRM documentation, administrative tasks, required training, and pharmacovigilance responsibilities, including adverse event and product complaint reporting. Conduct all activities in full compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and company policies. Qualifications Advanced scientific or clinical degree required (MD, PharmD, PhD, DNP, NP, PA, or equivalent). Medical Science Liaison (MSL) requires Doctorate degree OR Master’s degree & 3 years of Medical Affairs experience Senior Medical Science Liaison (Senior MSL) requires Doctorate degree & 2 years of Medical Affairs experience OR Master’s degree & 6 years of Medical Affairs experience Prior experience in cell therapy, CAR-T, immunology, rheumatology, nephrology, neurology, hematology/oncology, or rare diseases strongly preferred. Strong understanding of clinical trial design, clinical development, and medical affairs functions. Experience engaging with academic medical centers, specialty treatment centers, and/or infusion centers preferred. Ability to interpret and communicate complex scientific and clinical information to diverse audiences. Excellent presentation, communication, and interpersonal skills. Demonstrated ability to build strong external relationships and collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams. Comfortable operating within a fast-paced, high-growth biotechnology environment. Willingness and ability to travel extensively within assigned geography. Experience supporting pre-commercial or launch-stage biotechnology organizations. Knowledge of autoimmune disease treatment landscapes and emerging cell therapy approaches. Experience supporting investigator-sponsored research and clinical trial recruitment initiatives. Familiarity with cell therapy operational concepts including chain of identity, chain of custody, and treatment center workflows. For MSL the national salary range for this position is from $170,000 to $185,000 USD annually. For Sr. MSL the national salary range for this position is from $190,000 to $210,000 USD annually. This salary range is an estimate of what we reasonably expect to pay for this posted position, and the actual salary may vary based on various factors, including without limitation individual education, experience, tenure, skills and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. This position is also eligible for bonus, benefits, and participation in Company’s stock plan.

items.title: Mac MSP Help Desk Guru (work from home)
items.summary: Headquarters: ignitionit.com URL: https://ignitionit.com APPLY HERE: https://go.cultureindex.com/p/bLvP56CvGHU Fully Remote · Work from home · Full-time (Eastern or Pacific time zones) · Apple-first TL;DR ignitionit.com is a seasoned, Apple-first MSP — in business for almost 30 years — and we're hiring a Help Desk Technician to be the friendly, cap
items.description: DevOps and Sysadmin Headquarters: ignitionit.com URL: https://ignitionit.com APPLY HERE: https://go.cultureindex.com/p/bLvP56CvGHU Fully Remote · Work from home · Full-time (Eastern or Pacific time zones) · Apple-first TL;DR ignitionit.com is a seasoned, Apple-first MSP — in business for almost 30 years — and we're hiring a Help Desk Technician to be the friendly, capable first voice our clients reach when something isn't working. This position is a remote, work-from-home, full-time role. We've written this as a junior-to-mid-level job description because that's where most great people start on our team. But if you're more seasoned — comfortable in identity, MDM, or security work — don't scroll past. We'd be delighted to find someone who can step in higher up the ladder, and we'll happily talk about a more senior scope and comp if that's you. What the actual job??? Unlike many IT shops, we believe that the technology is the tactic. The actual job is making people feel taken care of. One of our core values is “49% tech support, 51% human support.” You'll succeed by configuring devices, resetting access, untangling email, and chasing down the gremlin that's been haunting someone's conference room. But you'll know you succeeded when a client exhales and says, “Thank goodness you're on it!” That Warm Fuzzy Feeling™ is the actual product. The green lights on the dashboard are just how we get there. In a typical week, you might: Onboard a new hire at a fast-growing startup: provision their Mac, set up their Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 accounts, enroll the device in MDM, and make sure day one feels effortless. Offboard a departing employee cleanly — recover the laptop, revoke access, and close the loop so nothing's left dangling. All boxes checked, ticket notated and closed, client followed up with. Field a "my email stopped working" ticket that turns out to be a DNS thing, a phishing-filter thing, or a "they changed their password on their phone three weeks ago" thing. Help a family office or RIA get a touchy Zoom Room or conference-room AV setup behaving before a meeting — over the phone. Triage the queue so phones get answered fast, emails don't rot, and nobody feels forgotten — even when the honest answer is, “We're on it, but here's the realistic timeline." ⠀ You'll be the front line: helping with what you can, researching what you can't, and pinging the rest of the team when you're genuinely stuck. That last part is a skill, not a weakness — knowing when to ask is half the job. About ignitionit.com We're one of the oldest Apple Technical Partners on the planet, and one of the only certified Apple Premier Partners — that’s kinda like getting knighted by the ghost of Steve Jobs. We started where you’d expect to find Macs (creative agencies, non-profits, education) but our primary clients today are cutting-edge, venture-backed AI SaaS startups, VC and private equity firms, registered investment advisors — many of them operating under stringent compliance expectations (SOC 2, SEC). That means we hold ourselves to a higher standard than the scrappy shop we started as. Polished, reliable, security-minded work is the baseline now — but always with a smile! What hasn't changed: relationships are still our most valuable currency — with clients, with vendors, and with each other. We're a tight, supportive team. We teach each other what we know, cover for each other when life throws a punch, and care a little too much about doing things the right way. We're still a bit weird, and our clients seem to like us that way. We move fast, priorities shift, it’s not always documented (whatever it is), our tool set and list of supported platforms is sprawling, and some days the to-do list is longer than you'd like. If you can stay warm under pressure, create order out of chaos, learn new stuff fast because you love it, and speak up when you need help, you'll thrive here. If you need a rigid, fully-documented, never-changes environment where nobody trusts you with admin access, where you will be micro-managed so you never have to wonder whether or not you’re doing the right thing, this isn't it. You’ll have a ton of independence on our team, and freedom to use your best judgment to get the ball over the finish line, but that also means we expect you to be naturally responsible, honest, and highly accountable — to yourself, your teammates, and the clients. As they say, the price of freedom is eternal vigilance. The tech you'll work with (and grow into) Day one, you'll be living in: Apple at the core — macOS, iOS, Apple Business Manager, and MDM (Jamf / Iru / Intune / Workspace ONE / and more) Yes, PCs too — about one-third of our users are driving Windows Google Workspace and Microsoft 365 admin consoles Identity and access — SSO, MFA, and security keys (Okta, Entra ID, Yubikey, and friends) Lots of other security tools — our stack is constantly evolving and may vary from client to client The everyday productivity stack — Slack, Zoom, conference-room AV, networking basics (Meraki), and endpoint tooling ⠀ You don't need to know all of this. You need to be the kind of person who wants to. As you grow, there's a clear path into infrastructure administration, project architecture and implementation, and — for the right person — security and compliance work (phishing simulations, endpoint detection, SOC 2 / CIS / SEC readiness, due diligence questionnaire support, etc.). That's where our most senior people live, and it's wide open. Who we hope you are The hard requirements — we won't move forward unless you: Can work standard business hours in Eastern or Pacific time zones (we currently need both) Have a quiet home workspace and reliable broadband Have proven Apple aptitude — you actually use and like the Apple ecosystem Have at least 2 years of IT support experience on the job. Go-getters who are just getting started and can prove they have a deep, demonstrable history of teaching themselves technology for the sheer joy of it might also make the cut. ⠀ Everything else — and this is the longer list, on purpose. We figure technical skills are teachable; character takes a lot longer. So we're looking for someone who: Genuinely cares — about clients, teammates, and doing right by people Loves to learn, and proves it in how they spend their time Reads, and writes clearly — clear writing is clear thinking, and you'll do a lot of it Stays calm and kind with a frustrated person on the other end of the line Can tell the difference between good customer service and fantastic customer service, and refuses to settle for the former Notices when something's being done inefficiently and fixes it (you may boast about it later, that’s fine) Proofreads their own work (yes, we noticed whether you proofread your application) Has a sense of humor, and doesn't take themselves too seriously Regarding AI Our company founder/CEO is headquartered in the Bay Area. We work with innovative, ambitious companies developing AI products. Our team members hold a range of opinions about whether AI is “good or bad” for humans, but at the end of the day, we embrace the plain fact that it is here, we must embrace it to evolve, and our clients increasingly depend on us to help them embrace it, too, to help them evolve and stay competitive. Our CEO's opinion: AI will not replace human labor any time soon; rather, AI is a new opportunity to either (a) get things done faster, or (b) get a much higher quality of output than before. If you’re an AI tinkerer, great! We want to hear how you’re using it and see your latest vibe project. If you’re allergic to AI or have no interest in learning new habits to work effectively with it, this is not the place for you. Compensation & logistics Base salary: For applicants closer to the junior side who are located in the USA, $50,000–$65,000/yr, depending on experience level and your local geographical price index. With experience, comp goes up from there. Genuinely experienced, more senior candidates can be slotted higher — let's talk. Applicants outside the USA will be compensated according to your local employment market. Type & location: Full-time, work from home, fully remote. Eastern or Pacific time zones. Benefits: Medical / dental / vision for the employee, 401(k) with employer contribution, 2 weeks of PTO annually to start, and a stipend for your home internet. How to apply The first step is really easy and only takes 10 minutes — no resume, no cover letter, no essays. Here's how: Take this online Culture Index assessment (about 10 minutes): We use it to screen for people whose natural wiring fits how our team works. If your profile lines up with what we're looking for, we'll reach out and ask you to complete a 60-minute TestGorilla assessment for critical thinking skills, send us your resume, and maybe a couple of other items. From there, we conduct between 2-4 video interviews. One of these might be a live technical assessment. If the Culture Index step feels like a strange way to start a job application — that's kind of the point. Remember the phrase Think Different? Ignition is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome and will consider all qualified applicants. Good luck in your search — and may the Force be with you! To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/ignition-inc-mac-msp-help-desk-guru-work-from-home

items.description: Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked. That is the whole job. Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client’s name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business. So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client’s face. At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero. Google is where we are putting our next round of growth. You would own a set of those accounts end to end. Here is what “end to end” actually means. You are the account manager. We do not have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else’s summary of your result. You own the whole funnel, not the campaign. Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client’s Shopify theme. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list. You are skeptical of your own numbers. You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard. You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls. Where you live is up to you. Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too. You are not a fit if “That was not my role” is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed. You want to be told what to do this week. You need a ticketing system to know what matters. You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question. Why this role is exciting This is not a maintenance job. Google is where we are putting our next round of growth, and you would have real influence over how we run it. You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale. You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident. You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

items.description: Data and Analytics At The Coca-Cola Company, we believe data is the foundation for creating personalized experiences and powering sustainable growth in today's digital-first world. As consumers engage with our brands in more connected ways than ever before, we are investing in advanced data and analytics platforms to unlock deeper insights, accelerate decision-making, and enable seamless innovation at scale. In this role as a Sr. Data Engineer - Integrations, you will drive the technical strategy and architecture for how data flows across our enterprise ecosystem. By leveraging your expert-level proficiency in Spark, Scala/Java development, and JVM-based engineering, you will design scalable data products. Core Responsibilities Architect and oversee enterprise-scale data integration pipelines and data products. Establish Medallion architecture patterns (Bronze, Silver, Gold) within Microsoft Fabric to ensure data quality, scalability, and reusability. Optimization: Act as the ultimate escalation point for complex Spark performance tuning. Deep-dive into Catalyst optimizer query plans, JVM memory profiling, and advanced partitioning strategies to resolve platform-wide bottlenecks and maximize cost efficiency. Complex Backend System Design: Lead the system design and architecture of highly available, REST-based microservices and APIs on the JVM, enabling seamless, low-latency interoperability between complex internal and external systems. Engineer modular, testable, and maintainable code applying functional programming principles and industry-best patterns for reliability and performance. Optimize workflows through data partitioning strategies, storage formats, and platform configurations to enable high-performance querying and cost efficiency. Engineering Excellence & Mentorship: Champion the "You Build It, You Run It" philosophy. Define the standards for functional programming and SOLID principles in Scala. Conduct architectural reviews, lead code quality initiatives, and mentor Grade 10 and junior engineers. CI/CD & Automation: Architect and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Maven, and SBT to automate testing, deployment, and configuration of data artifacts. Required Qualifications & Experience Expert Scala & JVM Architecture: Expert-level proficiency in Scala programming and JVM internals. Demonstrated ability to design concurrent, modular systems using advanced functional programming concepts. Advanced Spark Expertise (5+ years): Deep, hands-on experience building, debugging, and optimizing enterprise-grade distributed computing applications using Apache Spark (Scala preferred). Proven track record of solving complex data skew and memory management issues at scale. Data Architecture & Strategy: Extensive experience designing scalable data models (STAR, Vault, Tabular) and building out Medallion architectures for complex enterprise analytics and structured streaming applications. Backend & API Engineering: Proven experience architecting and scaling REST-based microservices and robust backend applications on the JVM. Synapse/Fabric Leadership (4-5+ years combined): Deep architectural experience transforming large data ecosystems using Azure Data Services (Synapse, Fabric, ADF, Azure Functions). DevOps & CI/CD Mastery: Proven ability to architect automated release cycles and infrastructure deployment. Hands-on expertise with Git, GitHub Actions, build tools (Maven/SBT), and configuring environments for parallel development. Delivery: Experience in Agile development (Scrum, lean techniques) and collaborating with global engineering teams. Location(s): Mexico City/Cities: Mexico Travel Required: 00% - 25% Relocation Provided: No Job Posting End Date: August 29, 2026 Our Purpose and Growth Culture: We are taking deliberate action to nurture an inclusive culture that is grounded in our company purpose, to refresh the world and make a difference. We act with a growth mindset, take an expansive approach to what's possible and believe in continuous learning to improve our business and ourselves. We focus on four key behaviors - curious, empowered, inclusive and agile - and value how we work as much as what we achieve. We believe that our culture is one of the reasons our company continues to thrive after 130+ years. Visit Our Purpose and Vision to learn more about these behaviors and how you can bring them to life in your next role at Coca-Cola. It falls in the middle of the range for your role, indicating performance at target.
